items.content:
In brief
- Polygon Labs expanded its Open Money Stack—a bundle of stablecoin payments tools—to Solana.
- The platform aims to collapse the multi-provider complexity of crypto payments into one connection.
- The move rides Solana’s payments momentum and extends Polygon’s push, including its Coinme acquisition.
Polygon Labs is extending its stablecoin payments infrastructure to Solana, giving businesses on the rival network a single connection to pull money in from bank accounts, move crypto across chains, and pay out to customers and suppliers worldwide.
The company said the expansion brings its Open Money Stack, a bundle of payments tools, to Solana for the first time.
The pitch addresses a persistent headache in crypto payments: sending the tokens is the easy part, but getting money from a bank account into a wallet, converting it and landing it back in a recipient’s bank account typically requires stitching together several providers, each with its own integration and contract.
Open Money Stack collapses that into one technical connection and one commercial relationship, with businesses free to adopt the whole thing or mix individual pieces into their existing systems.
Through the platform, a Solana business can connect bank, card, cash, and crypto funding routes, spin up embedded wallets, route and convert funds across networks including Polygon, Ethereum and Tron, and deliver payouts into banks, cards, or wallets. A remittance provider, for instance, could take dollars from a sender, deliver USDC on Solana, and connect the recipient to a bank payout.
“Every bank and fintech that wants to use crypto faces the same problem: connecting them to the accounts and payment systems its customers already use,” said Sandeep Nailwal, co-founder and CEO of the Polygon Foundation, adding that adding Solana lets more businesses build on the network their customers choose.
Cross-border payments firm Kira is among the first to adopt Solana through the stack, using it to help clients turn stablecoin transfers into dollars in their bank accounts to pay overseas suppliers.
The move reflects Solana’s growing pull as a payments venue, having processed more than $5 trillion in stablecoin volume this year, per the Solana Foundation.
The network recently rolled out an institutional settlement standard with input from J.P. Morgan and went live with its Alpenglow upgrade. For Polygon, the expansion builds on its broader payments push, including its acquisition of crypto-cash firm Coinme.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Polygon expands Open Money Stack to Solana, after Tron rollout
The move follows the addition of Tron support and Polygon’s acquisition of Coinme.
Polygon Labs is expanding Open Money Stack, its suite of services connecting bank accounts, crypto wallets and payouts, to the Solana network.
The expansion lets businesses building on Solana use Open Money Stack to accept funding from bank accounts, provide customer wallets and arrange payouts.
Polygon Labs CEO Marc Boiron told Cointelegraph that customer demand and stablecoin activity drove the decision to expand to Solana and, earlier this month, Tron.
Solana recorded about $5.76 trillion in stablecoin transfers between Jan. 1 and Oct. 27, while Tron recorded $6.94 trillion in stablecoin transfers over the same period, according to Token Terminal data.
“As that activity grows, connecting Solana to bank accounts, wallets and global payout networks allows businesses to deliver stablecoin payments to more customers and markets,” said Vibhu Norby, chief product officer, Solana Foundation.
Polygon’s Trails service has supported transfers between Solana and Ethereum-compatible networks since August. The latest expansion adds access to bank, card and cash funding, customer accounts, embedded wallets and payouts through the same integration, Boiron said.
“We hear from businesses that their customers and payment activity are already spread across networks and that they don’t want to force a chain choice or stitch together a bank provider, wallet, routing service and payout partner for each one,” he said.
The broader stack was already available for eligible uses on Polygon, Ethereum and other Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) networks, he added.
Last year, ecosystem data provider The Grid cataloged 478 companies and 261 projects in the Solana ecosystem. Boiron said Kira, which provides US dollar accounts and stablecoin-based cross-border payment services to businesses, is among the first customers using the Solana integration.
The Solana expansion follows Polygon’s completed acquisition of Coinme, which gave its US payments business access to 37 money transmitter licenses and 11 state exemptions, covering 48 states.
Related: Polygon gains US payments licenses after closing Coinme deal

items.content:
In brief
- The FCA has settled its High Court case against HTX, securing undertakings that the exchange will not target or solicit UK consumers.
- HTX has stopped taking deposits and new sign-ups from the UK, and existing UK users have 48 hours to withdraw their assets, the exchange said.
- The case was the FCA's first against a crypto firm under UK financial promotion rules, and the terms of the settlement are confidential.
Crypto exchange HTX is leaving the UK after settling a lawsuit brought by the Financial Conduct Authority over illegal crypto promotions, the regulator said on Thursday.
The FCA said it had secured undertakings in the High Court that HTX, formerly known as Huobi, will not knowingly promote crypto services unlawfully to UK consumers. Huobi Global S.A., the Panama-registered company named as the first defendant, has undertaken not to communicate financial promotions in breach of UK law across HTX's website, apps and social media, according to the court order.
HTX, which names Tron founder Justin Sun as a global adviser, is no longer active in the UK, the regulator said. UK consumers can no longer make deposits, and new UK users cannot sign up.
"Crypto firms should be under no illusion: being based overseas does not put them beyond the reach of UK law," said Steve Smart, the FCA's executive director of enforcement and market oversight. "The message to other firms is clear: follow the rules or face the consequences."
HTX said it had "proactively implemented measures to align with the UK's financial promotion regulations," the Financial Times reported. On its website, the exchange said existing UK customers are blocked from trading and have 48 hours to withdraw their assets before their accounts are closed.
The terms of the settlement are confidential, and it does not amount to an admission of liability or wrongdoing, the FCA said.
The regulator began proceedings against HTX in October 2025, its first enforcement case against a crypto firm under the UK's financial promotion rules, saying the exchange had repeatedly failed to engage with it. The two sides began settlement talks in March, which were extended in June, according to court orders reported by Reuters.
In May, the UK sanctioned Huobi Global S.A. over alleged support for Russia's financial sector, with the government's notice listing HTX as another name for the designated entity.
Two months later, the European Union named Huobi Global in its 21st package of Russia sanctions, accusing it of "significantly frustrating" the bloc's measures and barring EU transactions with the exchange, though stopping short of a full asset freeze. HTX has said Huobi Global S.A. is "distinct from the online HTX exchange."

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
Chainalysis traces North Korean crypto cash-outs through Garantex
The analysis followed US sanctions against 10 people and one entity accused of helping North Korean IT worker schemes fund weapons programs.
Blockchain analytics company Chainalysis mapped a long-running network of Russian intermediaries that helped North Korean IT workers cash out millions of dollars in cryptocurrency.
The US Treasury Department’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) sanctioned 10 individuals and one entity on Wednesday for supporting North Korean government-run IT worker schemes that it said funded the country’s weapons programs, according to a press release.
Those sanctioned included Russian nationals Ilya Aleksandrovich Boykov and Vitold Viktorovich Obertas. Treasury said Boykov had converted about $3.5 million in crypto for sanctioned company Alis since 2024, while Obertas had handled nearly $2 million in crypto conversions for North Korean officials since January 2025.
In one example, a wallet linked to a North Korean IT worker received regular stablecoin payments, converted them into Ether (ETH) and transferred the funds through consolidation addresses to Boykov, according to Chainalysis’ Wednesday report. Boykov then sent the cryptocurrency to Russian exchange Garantex to cash out.
North Korean IT workers using false identities to obtain jobs at crypto companies have posed a persistent security threat. In June 2025, the US Department of Justice announced charges against four North Korean nationals over a scheme involving fraudulent IT employment and the theft of more than $900,000 from US and Serbian crypto companies.
Related: US sanctions Sinaloa cartel-linked Ethereum addresses
items.title: Chainalysis traces North Korean crypto cash-outs through Garantex

items.content: ![image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/paradigmxyz/reth/main/assets/reth-2.png) Reth v2.9.0 replaces revm with [evm2](https://github.com/alloy-rs/evm2) as reth's EVM ([#25002](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/25002)). This is a breaking change for SDK users who build on reth's EVM, executor or inspector types. Node operators don't need to change any config. The release also fixes engine, RPC, storage and pipeline-unwind bugs, adds snap sync progress metrics and JIT support in reth-bb, and makes builds noticeably lighter by cutting monomorphization and unused dependencies. evm2 makes block execution about 10% faster than revm. On 500 mainnet blocks, execution throughput rose +10.0% and median block execution time fell 10.5%. On 300M-gas big blocks, throughput rose 9.3%, and 6.6% with BALs. ## Action Required **SDK users:** revm types are replaced by evm2 (`evm2`, `evm2-inspectors`, `evm2-jit`). Custom EVMs, precompiles, inspectors and executors need porting to evm2's APIs. ## Backwards Compatibility > [!IMPORTANT] > You can downgrade to v2.8.1. ## Update Priority | User Class | Priority | |---|---| | Payload Builders | Medium | | Non-Payload Builders | Medium | ## Breaking Changes ### SDK - Replaced revm with evm2 across execution, RPC and inspectors ([#25002](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/25002), [#28127](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28127), [#28169](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28169)) - RPC crates no longer depend on `reth-node-api` ([#28145](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28145)) ## Features ### Sync - Snap sync now reports progress metrics ([#28059](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28059)) ### SDK - reth-bb supports the evm2 JIT ([#28140](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28140)) ## Performance - Faster builds and smaller binaries: less per-table monomorphization in db commands and viewers, type-erased task spawns, and network and config code compiled once ([#28111](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28111), [#28142](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28142), [#28112](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28112), [#28141](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28141), [#28144](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28144), [#28143](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28143)) - DB table handles and metrics are indexed by table position ([#28134](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28134)) - Lighter dependency tree: smolgen replaces vergen, OTLP builds only with the `otlp` feature, RocksDB drops unused codecs and jemalloc ([#28122](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28122), [#28124](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28124), [#28147](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28147), [#28152](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28152), [#28108](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28108), [#28109](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28109), [#28119](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28119), [#28110](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28110)) ## Bug Fixes ### Engine & EVM - The precompile cache now survives big-block segments ([#28162](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28162)) - Recreated account state stays in the execution cache ([#28148](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28148)) ### RPC - Call allowance now reserves blob fees ([#28113](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28113)) - Proof responses match execution-apis ([#28091](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28091)) - The shared HTTP/WS server stops only once ([#28120](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28120)) ### Storage & Pipeline - Interrupted pipeline unwinds resume ([#28067](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28067)) - Safe-no-sync rollback is bounded by a sync period ([#28163](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28163)) - State import writes the right slots and history lookups ([#28053](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28053)) - Static-file read errors are propagated, and unwind errors name the segment and anchor ([#28064](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28064), [#28164](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28164)) - Snapshot block counts and downloads line up ([#28058](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28058)) ### Trie - Proof targets are grouped by child ([#28085](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28085)) ### Networks - tokio 1.53.3 and an updated webpki that distrusts emSign ([#28101](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28101), [#28050](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28050)) ## Dependencies - evm2 `f93318f` (git), evm2-inspectors and evm2-jit at the same rev - Morning Minute is a daily newsletter written by Tyler Warner. The analysis and opinions expressed are his own and do not necessarily reflect those of Decrypt. And check out our daily news show 'FOMO HOUR' covering all of the top stories and market action.
GM!
Today’s top news:
- Crypto majors rebound fall 1-2% alongside stocks; BTC at $80k
- HYPE soars on news of partnership with NYSE to bring perps to the US
- BTC ETFs see another $137M net inflows, flipping October green
- Visa stablecoin settlement volume 10x’s year over year
- YCombinator names its 6 crypto focus areas focused around crypto AI, stablecoins, and tokenization
Hedge Funds Left the BTC ETF Trade and Sovereign Wealth Stepped In
Every quarter, big institutions have to tell the SEC what they own. Add up those filings from just before Bitcoin’s October 2025 high through the end of June, and the picture is clear: nine hedge funds and banks sold about 68,000 Bitcoin worth of ETF shares over those nine months, roughly $5.4 billion at today’s prices. Millennium, Brevan Howard, Goldman Sachs, D.E. Shaw and five others led the selling. Some trimmed by a third. Some sold everything.
The trade had nothing to do with believing in Bitcoin. You buy the ETF, you simultaneously bet against Bitcoin in the futures market, and you pocket the gap between those two prices. Done right you make money whether Bitcoin rises or falls—as long as the gap beats what you’d earn just parking the cash in Treasury bills.
Before the high, that gap paid 7.9% a year, a full 3.9 points better than T-bills. By late October it paid 4.8%, barely half a point better. After fees and financing, Galaxy’s Alex Thorn figures what’s left is about 1.5 points over cash. Not worth the trouble.
“That arithmetic, not the price, is why the multi-strategy desks left,” he wrote.
You can see it in the futures data too. Both sides of that trade shrank by nearly identical amounts, around 57% each.
Now look at who came in and bought. Morgan Stanley’s wealth management arm. Mubadala. The Abu Dhabi Investment Council. Roughly 2,200 other filers added about 20,000 Bitcoin between them. Hedge funds sold; sovereign funds and wealth managers bought. And the investors too small to file at all—advisers, family offices, regular people—cut their holdings by just 6.6% while the price fell 49%. So Middle America is hodling.
That’s the whole story. The people who were never really Bitcoin investors left. The people who were didn’t flinch.
Since June, the funds have added back 87,000 Bitcoin—this time as straightforward buying, not arbitrage.
The rate picture is turning too. The Fed held Wednesday, but December has quietly softened: a month ago traders put 59% odds on two rate hikes by year-end. Today that’s zero. Expected tightening has been cut roughly in half. Less tightening helps every risk asset.
October’s flows already show the shift. The month was down $907 million at the midpoint. Through Tuesday it’s essentially flat, with $724 million arriving in just the last eight sessions.
The fast money is gone. The believers are left. And that’s the foundation you can build on for a bull market rally…
🌎 Macro Crypto and Markets
- Crypto majors are red though HYPE is soaring on NYSE partnership; BTC -1.6% at $80k; ETH -2% at $2,320; SOL -3% at $100; HYPE +7% at $88; ZEC -3% at $1,270
- Top alt movers include PI (+3%), SPX (+4%) and STABLE (+2%)
- Oil even at $102; Gold -0.1% at $4,040
- Stock futures are red after Google fell 7% post earnings; DOW -0.28%, Nasdaq -1%
- The Fed held rates at 3.75%–4.00% in a 10-2 vote with both dissenters favoring another quarter-point hike
- NYSE parent Intercontinental Exchange is partnering with Trade.xyz to launch regulated perpetual futures in the U.S., per Bloomberg, with the venue running on Hyperliquid’s infrastructure and offering contracts pegged to equities, indexes, commodities and FX, pending regulatory approval, and ICE taking an equity stake in Trade.xyz on undisclosed terms
- CZ said the real demand for tokenized U.S. stocks comes from outside America, telling The Rollup’s Andy that people abroad struggle to open U.S. brokerage accounts and noting that some countries with over 100 million people have stock markets trading just $50 million a day, while arguing tokenization could also open markets for assets with no real venue at all, like water and rare earth minerals.
- JPMorgan, Coca-Cola, Dell, AMD, Adobe, Applied Materials and Sandisk joined the issuers blocking tokenized versions of their shares on the OKX-ICE venue, taking the count to 33 in thirteen days
- Visa’s stablecoin settlement volume has passed $25B annualized, more than 10x where it was last year
- Y Combinator named six crypto priorities for the next six months in its October request for startups: AI-powered fundraising, USD and non-USD stablecoins, stablecoin neobanks, real-world asset tokenization, trading platforms, and API infrastructure for AI agents; arguing growth is now driven by institutional adoption rather than retail speculation
- A new Ipsos survey for the DeFi Education Fund found 22% of American adults have tried crypto, up from 18%, while past-year usage stayed flat at 13%; meaning essentially all the growth came from people who tried it and walked away.
- Blockchain data provider Allium, whose customers include Visa, Stripe and Coinbase, disclosed unauthorized access to its systems on October 25 and revoked every existing API key, telling customers to reset passwords, enable multifactor authentication and issue new credentials
Corporate Treasuries & ETFs

Unlimit founder backs Phase blockchain with $45M as mainnet launches
Phase’s new network lets smartphone owners earn tokens for validating transactions and sharing internet connections with AI agents.
Phase, a new blockchain that lets smartphone users earn tokens by helping run AI services, has received a $45 million funding commitment from Unlimit founder Kirill Eves.
Phase announced the launch of its blockchain on Thursday alongside Phase Proxy, a service that routes AI agents’ web requests through internet connections shared via smartphones.
Phase has no outside investors, the company told Cointelegraph. Eves’ $45 million commitment covers its first two years of development and provides another two years of runway.
“Websites routinely block or rate-limit automated traffic originating from data centers, even when an agent is acting on a legitimate user request,” Eves told Cointelegraph. “As agents take on more tasks across multiple websites, these restrictions are becoming a significant barrier to their adoption.”
Internet infrastructure provider Cloudflare allows website owners to manage AI traffic. For new domains, its settings block agent and training traffic on pages displaying ads.
Eves founded Unlimit in 2009 and built it into a global payments company. Unlimit said in December 2025 that it served more than 50,000 businesses worldwide.
Related: Cloudflare introduces wallets for AI agents, plans stablecoin payments
How smartphone users earn PHASE
Smartphone users can join the Phase network through the Phase app and earn PHASE tokens by validating blocks and sharing their internet connection through the proxy service.
“Current flagship smartphones can deliver approximately 35–45 TOPS [trillions of operations per second] of AI processing performance, depending on the device, allowing them to run smaller open-weight AI models locally,” Eves said.
Related: Tech chief says EU can fend off rogue AI risk: Report
Participation is adjusted based on a device’s battery level and connectivity.
Phase plans AI computing services in November
Smartphone users will be able to contribute computing power when Phase launches its AI computing service, planned for November. A second service expected in November will route requests across AI models.
Phase said that it plans to develop its own model and expand to desktops, servers and graphics processing units.
Part of the revenue from these services would fund PHASE purchases on the open market, which would be used to reward node operators.

HTX agrees to halt unlawful UK crypto promotions after FCA case
HTX has pledged to stop crypto marketing in the UK until October 2031, with deposits and new account registrations already blocked there.
Update (Oct. 29, 2026 at 13:30 UTC): This article has been updated to include HTX’s UK exit and withdrawal arrangements and background on Justin Sun.
Cryptocurrency exchange HTX has agreed to stop unlawfully promoting its services to consumers in the United Kingdom under a settlement announced Thursday by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA).
Huobi Global S.A., the Panamanian company behind HTX, agreed that it would not knowingly run illegal promotions, including through the exchange’s website, apps or social media. The court undertakings run until Oct. 21, 2031.
The settlement terms are confidential, and the agreement does not constitute an admission of liability or wrongdoing.
“Crypto firms should be under no illusion: being based overseas does not put them beyond the reach of UK law,” said Steve Smart, executive director of enforcement and market oversight at the FCA. “The message to other firms is clear: follow the rules or face the consequences.”
In an Oct. 16 notice outlining its UK exit arrangements, the exchange formerly known as Huobi said existing UK accounts could no longer deposit or trade. Eligible users can request a one-time 48-hour window to withdraw remaining assets, subject to approval and compliance checks. Accounts will close after all assets have been withdrawn.
The FCA brought the case in October 2025 and announced it in February, which it said was the agency’s first enforcement action against a crypto firm over illegal marketing.
HTX’s Sun ties and sanctions history
HTX counts Tron founder Justin Sun as an adviser. Sun has invested in crypto projects linked to US President Donald Trump, including World Liberty Financial and the TRUMP memecoin.
Sun sued World Liberty in April over the freezing of his WLFI tokens. The company filed a defamation suit against him in May, with Sun denying its allegations.
The settlement in the UK follows separate sanctions against the exchange in the country and European Union.
The UK sanctioned Huobi Global on May 26, imposing an asset freeze over suspected support for Russia’s government. HTX said the company was separate from the exchange, but UK authorities said the platform was covered because Huobi Global owned it.
The EU followed on July 23, imposing a transaction ban on HTX that took effect on Aug. 23.
Related: HTX denies UK sanctions allegations as new data flags $7.6B Russia-linked flows

items.content:
Bitcoin lending and yield could drive next wave of institutional demand, Rootstock says
A new report argues that putting institutional Bitcoin holdings to work through lending, collateral and financing could create demand beyond its store-of-value role.
A new report from Bitcoin infrastructure developer RootstockLabs argues that Bitcoin’s next wave of institutional demand could come from lending, yield generation and balance-sheet financing, expanding its role beyond a store of value.
RootstockLabs estimates that just 1.5% of Bitcoin’s (BTC) supply currently participates in lending and Bitcoin-native finance, while identifiable institutional investors hold roughly 3.9 million BTC. Putting more of those holdings to work could create additional demand for the asset without changing its fixed supply.
The analysis identifies two emerging sources of financial utility: generating returns from existing Bitcoin holdings through lending and structured credit, and using Bitcoin alongside fiat-denominated liabilities to improve corporate balance-sheet efficiency. RootstockLabs argues that both could encourage institutions to acquire and retain more BTC.
Bitcoin’s evolving financial utility compared with traditional assets. Source: RootstockLabs report
The report outlines a hypothetical scenario in which institutional Bitcoin holdings double to 7.8 million BTC. If 5% of those holdings earned a 5% annual yield, institutions would collectively generate 19,500 BTC a year. The figure represents potential returns on existing holdings, not a forecast of new Bitcoin demand.
Drawing a comparison to gold, the report argues that successful monetary assets develop additional sources of demand beyond their original role as stores of value. While gold found uses in jewelry and electronics, RootstockLabs sees Bitcoin’s next source of utility emerging through financial markets.
Related: Bitcoin ETF inflows climb to $176M as BTC rebounds above $80K
Could Bitcoin’s financialization introduce new risks?
Asked about the risks associated with Bitcoin’s growing financialization, Tony DiCarlo, director of institutional propositions at RootstockLabs and author of the report, acknowledged the concerns but argued that Bitcoin’s underlying design offers important advantages. He told Cointelegraph:
Yes, financialisation carries real risks. Fractional reserves, rehypothecation and excess leverage can grow around any scarce asset. Bitcoin’s traits reduce some of that risk as collateral is verifiable on-chain, liquidation rules are programmable and the supply of collateral cannot be diluted.
DiCarlo said borrower defaults, custody failures and legal enforceability remain concerns, while Bitcoin’s volatility adds to leverage risks.
However, he argued that the benefits of financialization could far outweigh those risks, pointing to MARA’s $750 million in Bitcoin-backed loans to help finance a planned power plant acquisition in Ohio. The arrangement allows MARA to retain its Bitcoin holdings while using them as collateral to finance real-world infrastructure.
Bitcoin’s key features for modern finance. Source: RootstockLabs report
DiCarlo also acknowledged that institutional adoption could concentrate Bitcoin holdings among a small number of custodians. While spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds have been a major driver of institutional adoption, “shareholders own shares, not coins,” he said, warning that a few large custodians could end up holding most of the Bitcoin.
Nevertheless, DiCarlo maintained that Bitcoin’s decentralized architecture remains a fundamental advantage, allowing holders to retain control of their assets and enabling financial services with fewer intermediaries, potentially reducing counterparty risks and fees.
Bitcoin’s defining trait is that nobody owns it and you don’t need an intermediary to use it. Holders keep control of their keys and because there are fewer middlemen, financial services built on Bitcoin can carry less counterparty risk and fewer fees. Those advantages draw users in and they reward the builders who design around them.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
items.content:
Coinbase seeks Brazil crypto license, expects no service disruption
Coinbase has applied for authorization ahead of Brazil’s Oct. 30 deadline and says it expects to maintain existing services while regulators review its application.
Coinbase has applied for authorization to operate as a crypto service provider in Brazil ahead of the country’s license application deadline on Friday.
The US-based cryptocurrency exchange submitted its application to the Central Bank of Brazil on Wednesday under the country’s virtual asset service provider (VASP) framework, according to a statement shared with Cointelegraph.
The filing aims to maintain Coinbase’s existing Brazilian operations as the central bank introduces new requirements covering governance, customer asset safeguards and compliance.
“We do not expect the application review to require a suspension of our existing services,” a Coinbase spokesperson told Cointelegraph.
Coinbase also reiterated plans to bring its “Everything Exchange” strategy to Brazil, potentially expanding into foreign exchange and payments alongside crypto services. Those activities require separate regulatory authorizations.
Coinbase joins Binance, which applied for authorization on Oct. 23 but has restricted crypto lending, margin trading and other services in Brazil while delisting 22 crypto assets to comply with the new rules.
Brazil requires existing crypto service providers to apply for authorization by the end of October to continue operating under transitional arrangements. Existing providers that apply by the deadline can continue operating while their applications are reviewed.
Related: France proposes liability for crypto exchanges offering DeFi access
items.title: Coinbase seeks Brazil crypto license, expects no service disruption

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
EU investors rank crypto above retirement plans for lasting wealth creation: OKX survey
European investors ranked crypto above retirement plans for lasting wealth creation, while prior surveys show US investors are skeptical on crypto’s role in retirement accounts.
Investors in several of Europe’s biggest economies ranked crypto above retirement plans as lasting wealth creation tools, with 19% of those surveyed choosing cryptocurrencies, while 8% opted for traditional retirement plans.
US investors still preferred traditional retirement plans, with 21% choosing retirement accounts while only 12% opted for cryptocurrencies, according to a Thursday OKX survey of 1,932 adults age 18 to 88 who previously invested in crypto. The survey was conducted by Pollfish between Oct. 14 and Oct. 18 across the US, France, Germany, the Netherlands and Poland.
Real estate was the top choice for lasting wealth, with 34% of all respondents choosing the broad class above digital assets and retirement accounts, as the asset most associated with lasting wealth.
Younger Europeans have previously shown concerns about whether their retirement plans will provide sufficient income. About 43% of 2,000 surveyed Europeans age 18 to 35 expected their pensions to fall short, according to a May 2026 survey by Friends of Europe’s citizen-engagement unit, Debating Europe.
“When investors under 45 on both sides of the Atlantic treat crypto as part of their long-term wealth, it tells you crypto is now part of how people look at their finances,” said OKX Europe’s CEO, Erald Ghoo. He said that crypto’s place in the wealth plan will become “more important” as these investors get older and wealthier.
Over half of US investors plan to increase their crypto holdings, while boomers remain skeptical
Nearly half of European investors, 47%, expect to increase their holdings, including 13% planning a significant increase. Across all age groups, 51% expect to increase their crypto allocation. Boomers are the exception, with 55% saying crypto is not important to generational wealth.
Excluding boomers, US investors generally are more bullish on cryptocurrency’s place in their portfolio, with 55% of surveyed participants expecting to increase their allocation in the next five years and 22% planning a significant increase.
Still, American boomers were more pessimistic about crypto, with 65% saying that crypto was not at all important for generational wealth building, compared to 44% of boomers in Europe.
Related: Settlement concerns prompt Euronext to halt CoinShares’ Zcash ETP ahead of debut
Trump administration broadens retirement plan access to alternative assets
To be sure, Americans are also more skeptical about crypto’s place in retirement accounts. An August survey from The National Institute on Retirement Security found that 77% of Americans consider crypto in workplace retirement plans risky, including 46% who view it as very risky.
Earlier, however, the Trump administration took steps toward broadening access to alternative assets in retirement plans. In May 2025, the US Department of Labor rescinded crypto-specific guidance that had urged 401(k) plan fiduciaries to exercise “extreme care” when considering cryptocurrency investments, returning instead to a neutral approach that neither endorses nor discourages crypto.
In August 2025, President Donald Trump signed an executive order directing federal agencies to expand access to alternative assets in 401(k) plans, including exposure to digital assets through certain investment vehicles.
In March 2026, the US Department of Labor issued a draft proposal seeking to expand investment options in 401(k) retirement plans to include crypto and alternative investments.
In June 2026, SenatorsBernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren and Representative Bobby Scott urged the US Department of Labor to withdraw its proposal to allow digital assets in retirement plans, arguing that the policy would “expose retirement accounts to exceptionally volatile assets, like digital currency.”
Magazine: Made an ‘honest’ mistake with crypto taxes? New bill offers way out

items.content:
In brief
- OFAC sanctioned 10 individuals and one entity over North Korean IT worker schemes that defraud U.S. businesses and fund the country's weapons programs.
- Treasury says Russian nationals Ilya Boykov and Vitold Obertas converted millions of dollars in crypto for North Korean networks since 2024.
- The sanctions listings include Ethereum and Tron addresses, one of which is linked to both Russian men.
The U.S. Treasury Department has sanctioned 10 individuals and one entity for their roles in North Korean IT worker schemes that defraud U.S. businesses and generate revenue for the country's weapons programs, the department said on Wednesday.
North Korea uses fake documents, stolen identities and invented personas to place IT workers at legitimate companies, then takes most of their wages, generating hundreds of millions of dollars for its weapons of mass destruction and ballistic missile programs, according to Treasury. The networks have used "sophisticated cryptocurrency transactions," money laundering and artificial intelligence tools to move millions of dollars to the regime, it said.
Today, Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control sanctioned 10 individuals and one entity for their roles in Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK) government-run IT worker schemes that defraud U.S. businesses and generate revenue for the DPRK’s unlawful weapons of mass…
— Treasury Department (@USTreasury) October 28, 2026
"The North Korean regime continues targeting and exploiting American companies through fraudulent activities conducted by its overseas IT operatives, who weaponize sensitive data and extort businesses for substantial payments," said Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent.
Two Russian nationals are among those sanctioned. Vitold Obertas, a Russian intermediary for North Korean financial transactions, has carried out nearly $2 million in crypto conversions since January 2025, plus at least $1.25 million in other currency transactions, for North Korean officials, Treasury said. Ilya Boykov has exchanged and converted the equivalent of $3.5 million in crypto since 2024 for Limited Liability Company Alis, a North Korean IT worker company sanctioned in 2024.
The sanctions listings include two Ethereum and two Tron addresses for Boykov, and one Ethereum and three Tron addresses for Obertas. One Ethereum address appears on both men's entries.
Treasury also sanctioned the First Financial and Technical Development Center, a North Korean-controlled entity based in Vladivostok, Russia, that it said deploys highly trained IT workers who use AI tools and "complex cryptocurrency transfers" to generate revenue. Six Russia-based North Korean IT workers have generated more than $750,000 for the center since 2025, according to Treasury.
Two North Korean nationals who lead Russia-based IT worker delegations were also sanctioned. One of them, Kim Ki Hyok, has transferred nearly $500,000 in crypto for his delegation since 2024, Treasury said.
The action builds on sanctions against a separate North Korean IT worker network in March, and Australia and the European Union have made their own designations this month, according to Treasury.
North Korea's crypto operations
North Korean IT workers have increasingly targeted crypto projects. In April 2025, Google's Threat Intelligence Group reported that such workers had embedded themselves in crypto projects in the UK, Germany, Portugal and Serbia, including Solana smart contract development, with some operating under as many as 12 fake identities at once.
North Korean hackers have also used long-running deception campaigns against crypto firms. In April, Solana-based exchange Drift Protocol said the attack that drained about $285 million from its platform was a six-month operation by a North Korean state-affiliated group, whose intermediaries met Drift contributors in person and posed as a quantitative trading firm, Decrypt reported.

In brief
- Utah has filed felony charges against Kalshi and co-founders Tarek Mansour and Luana Lopes Lara, accusing them of illegally promoting gambling in the state.
- Prosecutors say an undercover state agent placed 12 sports wagers on Kalshi in September, despite a federal ruling that Utah's gambling laws apply to the platform.
- Kalshi called the charges "a crazy overreach," a day after the CFTC sued Utah to stop it from enforcing its gambling laws against federally regulated exchanges.
Utah has filed criminal charges against prediction market Kalshi and its two co-founders, accusing them of illegally promoting gambling in the state, ABC4 reported on Wednesday.
KalshiEX LLC, CEO Tarek Mansour and COO Luana Lopes Lara face one count of pattern of unlawful activity, a second-degree felony, 12 counts of online gambling promotion, a third-degree felony, and one count of gambling promotion, a misdemeanor, according to the charging documents.
"Gambling is illegal in Utah, whether you place the bet, run the game, or promote it. Calling it a 'prediction market' doesn't change what it is, and being federally registered doesn't put a company above the law," Utah Attorney General Derek Brown said in a statement.
According to the charges, a special agent with the Utah State Bureau of Investigation set up an undercover account as a Utah resident and placed 12 wagers on sports including NFL and college games in September, passing a location check that confirmed he was in the state. Kalshi earned proceeds from the fees it charged on each bet, prosecutors allege.
Brown's office did not say what penalties it would seek, though the felony charges carry the possibility of jail time, the Associated Press reported.
"This is a crazy overreach; Utah is clearly playing politics," Kalshi said in a statement. "We look forward to putting a stop to this in court, just like we did in Arizona."
Utah's fight with the CFTC
The charges escalate a dispute that already involves the federal government. Utah, where the state constitution bans gambling, sued Kalshi in state court last week. On Tuesday, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission sued Utah to block its enforcement actions against CFTC-registered exchanges, making it the 10th state the agency has taken to court.
"Congress entrusted the CFTC to be the federal regulator with sole responsibility to oversee these markets," CFTC Chairman Michael Selig said.
Utah has already won one round. In August, U.S. District Judge Robert Shelby rejected Kalshi's own bid to block enforcement, ruling that federal law "does not preempt Utah's ability to enforce its anti-gambling laws." Kalshi is appealing to the Tenth Circuit, which denied its request for an injunction in September.
President Donald Trump has backed the CFTC, saying in May that it was "critically important that the CFTC's exclusive authority over Prediction Markets is maintained," and calling several state officials who had challenged the platforms "scum."
Federal appeals courts have split on whether states can apply gambling laws to prediction markets. The Third Circuit ruled in April that New Jersey cannot regulate sports contracts on the platforms, while the Sixth and Ninth Circuits sided with Ohio, Tennessee and Nevada in August and September. New Jersey has asked the Supreme Court to settle the question, backed by 39 other states and the District of Columbia.
"Different judges in different places say different things," Isaac Rose-Berman, a gambling policy fellow at the American Institute for Boys and Men, told ABC4. "It's just going to keep escalating and eventually get to the Supreme Court."

items.content:
Cartesia升级H-Net：让大模型自己学会切分数据，训练效率最高提升约10倍

动察 Beating AI 快讯，大模型已经能自己学习语言，但文字该怎么切成 Token，通常还是由提前训练好的分词器决定。这能节省算力，却也限制了模型组织信息的方式。遇到陌生词汇或代码，固定的切分规则未必合适；如果完全不分词，直接逐字节处理，计算成本又会大幅增加。

AI 语音公司 Cartesia 在 2025 年 7 月提出 H-Net（分层网络），就是想解决这个矛盾。它让模型直接读取原始字节，自己学习如何切分和压缩信息。比如遇到陌生单词，起初可能拆成多个片段；随着这个词在上下文中反复出现，又会逐渐合并成更少的片段。这种变化在推理时也能发生，不需要重新训练。

如今 Cartesia 公布新版 H-Net，训练效率有了明显提升。在严格控制主要条件的实验中，达到相同验证损失所需的算力减少约 22%，下游评测的计算效率约翻倍。更大规模的实验中，新版 H-Net 仅用约 1 万亿 Token 等效数据，就在六项测试的平均分上追平了训练约 11 万亿 Token 的开源模型 SmolLM3，达到这一成绩所需的训练算力约为后者的十分之一。

这套方法也不局限于文字。团队用细菌和古菌基因组训练 H-Net，发现模型在处理人类基因片段时，能自行识别编码区每三个碱基一组的规律。相关 DNA 建模实验的计算效率提升约 6–7 倍。

声音不像文字那样有现成的词语边界，Cartesia 最初研究 H-Net，其实就是想让语音模型直接从连续声音中学出音素和单词，而不必依赖预先设计的切分规则。

Bitcoin long-term resistance in focus as analysis sees selling risk above $85K
BTC price analysis from Glassnode drew attention to $85,000 as the lower boundary of a cost-basis zone for long-term holders.
Bitcoin (BTC) faces resistance between $84,000 and $85,000 as analysis points to coins largely linked to a single large holder.
Key points:
- Bitcoin faces resistance around $85,000, where 4.3% of the BTC supply last moved onchain.
- Glassnode analysis links the onchain cost basis of 864,520 BTC to Bitcoin’s difficulty sustaining daily closes above $85,000.
- Long-term holders own a combined four million coins with a cost basis between $85,000 and $118,000.
Glassnode ties $85K resistance to large-holder cost basis
In the latest edition of its regular newsletter, The Week Onchain, crypto analytics platform Glassnode flagged another resistance hurdle for BTC price action in the mid-$80,000 range.
On Nov. 22, 2025, a significant portion of the total BTC supply moved onchain. At the time of the transactions, BTC/USD traded between $84,000 and $85,000. The coins that last moved at that price make up 4.3% of the total BTC supply, or 864,520 BTC.
The analysis links the majority of this Bitcoin to a single large holder, who was moving funds among multiple wallets. Although self-transfers generally do not affect price, Glassnode noted that Bitcoin has respected the $84,000-$85,000 range as both support and resistance over the past 11 months.
“It held as support in December, when price bounced off it on December 1 and December 18. It gave way on January 31, when a push back up to $84K failed, and Bitcoin fell about 20% over the following days,” Glassnode commented.
In May, September and October, BTC price upside momentum faded near the same level, with a high of $87,400. Bitcoin has recorded only five daily closes above the band, never more than three in a row.
“A run of daily closes above $85K would turn the band back into support,” Glassnode added.
BTC/USD chart with supply onchain cost-basis data. Source: Glassnode
Long-term holders pose sell-side risk above $85,000
The $85,000 mark holds significance for a larger portion of the Bitcoin investor base.
Related: Bitcoin price analysis sees ‘strong rally’ as old coins become dormant
Glassnode reports that Bitcoin’s long-term holders (LTH) — entities holding a given amount of BTC without selling for at least 155 days — own around 4 million coins that last moved onchain between $85,000 and $118,000, mostly in 2025.
“More than half of all their coins were bought above today’s price. If price recovers toward $85K, many of these holders may sell to get their money back,” it said of the LTH cohort as a whole.
Bitcoin supply data by investor cohort. Source: Glassnode
The LTH spent output profit ratio (SOPR), which compares the extent to which LTH coins moving onchain are doing so at a higher or lower price compared to their previous transaction, currently sits at 0.99. Values below 1 imply that LTH supply is moving at an aggregate loss.

items.content:
ECB President Christine Lagarde to step down in February 2027
Lagarde announced plans to step down as European Central Bank President after serving more than seven years in the role.
European Central Bank (ECB) President Christine Lagarde announced plans to step down from her role at the central bank.
“I have just informed my colleagues that I will step down as @ECB President on 7 February 2027,” Lagarde said in a Thursday post on X.
Lagarde became ECB president in November 2019 and will have served for about seven years and three months when she leaves office.
Her successor will be appointed by the European Council following the nomination process outlined in Article 283 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union. That process requires a recommendation from the Council, after consulting the European Parliament and the central bank, the ECB announced in a Thursday press release.
Reports of Lagarde’s exit emerged in February 2026, when anonymous sources told the Financial Times that she was considering leaving before her eight-year term ends in October 2027.
Under her presidency, the ECB advanced preliminary work on a digital euro designed for day-to-day payments and in September launched Pontes, a system allowing financial institutions to settle wholesale tokenized asset transactions in central bank money, providing an alternative to stablecoins.
Vocal crypto critic vowed no BTC in cenbank reserves
Lagarde has been a vocal critic of Bitcoin (BTC) and cryptocurrencies. During a press conference in January 2025, she said that central bank reserves need to be liquid, secure and safe,” adding that she was “confident” that Bitcoin would not enter the reserves of any of the central banks of the General Council.
A lawyer by profession, Lagarde previously served as the managing director of the IMF from 2011 to 2019 and was France’s Minister of the Economy.
She helped the ECB navigate several major crises, including the Covid-19 pandemic, Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and the subsequent energy crisis.
Related: Stablecoins won’t strengthen global role of euro, ECB’s Lagarde says
items.title: ECB President Christine Lagarde to step down in February 2027

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
蚂蚁UBTree改进推测解码：并行筛选草稿树，让大模型一次验证更多Token

动察 Beating AI 快讯，蚂蚁百灵开源了大模型推测解码方案 UBTree。

推测解码相当于让小模型提前「打草稿」，再由大模型一次验证多个 Token，减少逐个生成 Token 所需的计算轮次。

但草稿也有命中率的问题。小模型猜错得越早，后面能直接采用的内容就越少。此前已有技术会同时准备多条候选路径，把它们组成一棵草稿树，再剪掉不太可能被接受的分支。

UBTree 改进了筛选方法。它先并行预测后面几个位置可能出现的 Token，再用一个轻量级模型判断相邻 Token 能否合理衔接。不同组合可以同时评分，不必沿着每条路径反复运行模型。随后挑出更有希望的分支，组成草稿树交给大模型验证。

团队还调整了筛选模型的训练方式，让它不只关注概率最高的答案，也能识别值得保留的备选路径，使大模型每轮有机会接受更多 Token。

在 Qwen3-4B 的七项测试中，使用 DFlash 2 选择器构树的平均加速比为 5.95 倍。换成 UBTree 选择器并调整训练方法后，提高到 6.88 倍，相当于在原方案基础上进一步提升约 16%。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374374

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
时代的眼泪！Devv宣布停运：曾服务超百万开发者，AI搜索终成通用助手标配

动察 Beating AI 快讯，开发者 AI 搜索产品 Devv 宣布停运。创始人张佳圆表示，团队将把全部精力转向 AI Agent 协作平台 Multica。过去三年，Devv 累计服务了全球上百万开发者。

Devv 于 2023 年 10 月上线。当时，大模型还不擅长搜索最新的编程资料，开发者经常要在搜索引擎和 ChatGPT 之间来回切换。Devv 专门为程序员建立搜索索引，整合技术文档、GitHub 代码，再让 AI 直接给出答案。上线四周，周活跃用户就达到 2.5 万。后来推出付费订阅，首月收入超过 2.8 万美元。

但短短三年，AI 搜索已经不稀奇了。ChatGPT、Claude 都能联网查资料，Claude Code、Codex 等编程 Agent 更进一步，已经能自己查资料、写代码、运行测试，直接帮开发者完成任务。Devv 曾经引以为傲的差异化优势，逐渐成了通用 AI 工具的基础能力。

其实，张佳圆今年 5 月就透露过 Devv 将会下线。团队此前还尝试过 AI 编程产品 DevCode，最终也选择了放弃。

如今，他们把赌注押在 Multica 上。这次不再做搜索，也不自己造编程 Agent，而是让多个 Agent 像团队成员一样协作。你负责安排任务，它们负责执行、汇报进度，遇到问题主动反馈，完成后再交给你审核。

从「帮程序员找答案」到「让 AI 自己把活干完」，Devv 的退场，恰好见证了这三年开发者工具的变化。

美国中期选举进入冲刺阶段，市场提前围绕2028年总统大选政策重新定价

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，美国中期选举正进入最后冲刺阶段，投资者正评估国会控制权可能易手对金融市场更深远的影响，可能是提前启动围绕 2028 年总统大选的政策重新定价。

如果民主党同时控制国会两院，特朗普第二任期剩余两年的国内立法可能陷入更明显的僵局。财政预算、政府债务上限以及人工智能数据中心建设的监管争议，均可能成为两党交锋的重点。

MAI Capital Management 首席市场策略师 Chris Grisanti 认为，共和党仍有较大机会保住参议院。如果这一情景出现，股市可能迎来短暂的释然性反弹，但选举影响预计不会持续太久。

Cordoba Advisory Partners 首席执行官 Rami Sarafa 则认为，民主党若扩大国会影响力，医疗保障政策可能面临调整，人工智能数据中心的扩建也可能遭遇更多阻力。不过，由于相关项目建设周期较长，选举结果不会使人工智能投资热潮突然终止。

相比短期立法僵局，2028 年总统大选可能带来更广泛的政策预期变化。

摩根大通地缘政治研究中心将国内政策僵局、特朗普寻求留下政治遗产，以及 2028 年总统竞选启动，列为中期选举后值得关注的三条主线。其分析涉及伊朗和中东、俄乌冲突、拉丁美洲及北约等议题。摩根大通分析师指出，中期选举将开启有关 2028 年及以后美国政策方向的讨论。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
GitHub Copilot Fusion正式上线：跑分接近Claude Code，测试成本减半

动察 Beating AI 快讯，GitHub 在 Universe 2026 大会上正式推出多模型调度系统 Copilot Fusion。简单任务交给合适的模型，复杂任务可以先让便宜模型尝试，不行再换更强的模型，或者让不同模型互相检查。

独立评测机构 Artificial Analysis 的测试显示，Fusion Max 编程综合得分 60，接近 Claude Code 搭配 Opus 5.5 Max 的 62 分。Fusion Max 平均每题 API 成本为 5.59 美元，耗时约 36 分钟；Claude Code 搭配 Opus 5.5 Max 则需要 11.42 美元和约 60 分钟。Fusion 成本降低约 51%，耗时缩短约 40%。

动察 Beating AI 快讯，产品分析平台 Mixpanel 联合创始人、AI 图像平台 Playground 创始人 Suhail Doshi 再次创业，成立新公司 Particle，并推出首款模型 Particle-1。模型基于 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 进行强化学习后训练，重点减少 Coding Agent 执行任务时消耗的 Token。

省下来的 Token 主要来自更精简的推理、减少反复尝试，以及任务完成后及时停止。在一次 Git 部署测试中，两款模型都成功完成任务，但 Particle-1 只输出 15,892 个 Token，原版用了 47,006 个。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
开发者把32位CPU编进千问权重：大模型内部直接运行计算机程序

动察 Beating AI 快讯，独立开发者 Divyansh Agrawal 基于阿里 Qwen3.5-4B 做出了 Qwenputer，把一颗 32 位 RISC-V 虚拟 CPU 直接编进模型权重，让大模型无需调用外部计算工具，也能在生成回答时进行精确计算。

作者没有重新训练 Qwen，而是在原有 32 层网络前增加 11 层，用编译器将 CPU 的运算规则直接写成模型参数。新增网络还利用 Gated DeltaNet 结构实现了可精确读写的内存，用来存放程序和数据。

这颗虚拟 CPU 已能运行编译后的 C 程序，并通过了 RISC-V 指令测试，在累计执行约 1800 万条指令的测试中未发现错误。

在 DeepMind 的 40 道大数乘法题中，原版 Qwen 答对 22 道，Qwenputer 答对 39 道；原版 Qwen 接入外部 Python 后则全部答对。CPU 本身可以准确执行指令，但大模型仍可能在调用或输出结果时出错。

这条技术路线已有先例。今年 3 月，Percepta 就用神经网络实现了一台可以运行 C 程序的虚拟计算机。不过，它是专门构建的模型。Qwenputer 则把类似的计算能力接入已经训练好的 Qwen，让语言模型在生成回答时，也能使用内部 CPU 执行计算。

不过，这套方案目前效率很低。大量零值参数将模型文件撑至 18.8GB，约为原版两倍，计算速度也远不如外部工具。

英特尔Q3财报前瞻：AI服务器CPU需求受关注，机构聚焦Q4指引与扩产投入

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，英特尔将于美股周四盘后公布 2026 年第三季度财报，并于北京时间 10 月 30 日 5 时召开业绩电话会。彭博汇总的分析师预期显示，公司季度营收约 165 亿美元，同比增长约 21%；调整后每股收益约 0.40 美元，高于去年同期的 0.23 美元。公司此前给出的营收指引为 158 亿至 168 亿美元，调整后每股收益为 0.38 美元、调整后毛利率为 42%。

服务器 CPU 需求是本次财报的重要看点。市场预计，英特尔数据中心业务季度收入约 66 亿美元，个人电脑芯片业务收入约 88 亿美元。AI 需求正在拉动数据中心 CPU 销售，但个人电脑市场面临另一种压力：内存和存储价格上涨推动整机涨价，压低销量，同时抬高平均售价。

看多机构主要押注 CPU 供给紧张持续。New Street Research 分析师 Pierre Ferragu 将英特尔评级由「中性」上调至「买入」，目标价 125 美元，认为 AI 智能体快速发展带来的服务器 CPU 结构性短缺可能延续数年，支持公司数据中心业务及转型。KeyBanc 则维持「增持」评级及 155 美元目标价，预计第三季度营收 169 亿美元、每股收益 0.46 美元，均高于市场一致预期。

摩根大通分析师 Harlan Sur 的态度相对谨慎。他近期将评级由「减持」上调至「中性」，但维持 85 美元目标价。Sur 认可陈立武担任 CEO 后，公司在产品执行、制造良率及先进封装方面的改善，也认为 AI 智能体需求可能推动盈利预期继续上修；但他预计，英特尔仍可能经历数个季度的市场份额流失，尤其是在服务器 CPU 领域。

扩产投入也是后续指引的关键。首席财务官 David Zinsner 在 7 月接受路透社采访时表示，需求增长促使公司将 2026 年资本开支预期由 180 亿美元提高至 200 亿美元，2027 年支出还将明显增加。他同时指出，公司已签署部分期限为三至五年的 CPU 及专用芯片供货协议，但协议在市场条件变化时仍可能重新谈判。

Bitunix分析师：Fed暂停升息但分歧扩大，AI投资与能源通膨考验政策空间

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，美联准会以 10 比 2 维持联邦基金利率于 3.75% 至 4%，但两名官员主张升息 25 个基点，显示通膨风险已使政策分歧加深。Fed 指出美国经济活动仍强劲、国内支出具韧性，通膨则持续偏高；因此，按兵不动并不等于紧缩周期已经结束，后续仍取决于物价与金融条件的变化。

本次政策讨论的核心，是 AI 投资究竟能否抵御高利率。大型科技企业虽有充足现金，但数据中心营运商及基础设施供应商仍依赖外部融资，借贷成本上升可能逐步压缩资本支出。若 AI 投资对利率敏感，有限度的紧缩便可能扩大降温效果；若投资持续强劲，Fed 则可能被迫压抑房市、消费与企业需求，付出更高的成长代价。能源价格高企又增加通膨黏性，使政策判断更为复杂。

欧洲央行同样面临通膨与成长的拉锯，市场预期本次维持存款利率于 2.5%，但仍关注 12 月是否再度升息。能源成本推升物价风险之际，欧元区成长动能放缓，法国国债殖利率与风险溢价攀升，更可能透过融资成本收紧经济。若债市压力持续，央行即使维持抗通膨立场，也需衡量金融分化对成长的冲击。

对市场而言，关键已不只是央行本次是否升息，而是高利率能否有效抑制需求、又是否会意外压垮投资与信用。若能源通膨延续、AI 融资成本同步上升，全球金融条件可能进一步收紧；若成长先于通膨降温，政策制定者则将面临过度紧缩的风险。未来通膨数据、企业融资状况与欧美债市利差，将是判断政策路径的重要线索。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
OpenCode、Railway之后，Command Code也遇袭：黑客盯上AI模型密钥

动察 Beating AI 快讯，10 月 29 日，AI 编程工具 Command Code 宣布，已阻止一起与针对 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 模型的大规模蒸馏攻击有关的安全事件。公司预防性撤销了全部自家 API 密钥，用户需要重新登录生成新密钥。

过去两周，OpenCode 和 Railway 接连遭遇类似攻击。10 月 17 日，OpenCode 云端 Console 遭入侵，约 1.4% 的 Console 用户受影响，部分第三方模型密钥可能泄露，有用户报告被盗刷数百甚至上千美元。

10 月 21 日，Railway 也被攻破，最多约 10 万个工作区存在环境变量泄露风险。调查人员从攻击者的代码日志中发现，黑客专门搜索 AI 服务的 API 密钥。Railway 判断，攻击者很可能是想利用这些密钥大量调用模型，收集输出用于蒸馏。

更早的 10 月 14 日，Zeabur 也遭入侵。攻击者重点搜寻 AI API 密钥，甚至尝试使用窃取的 AWS 凭据调用 Amazon Bedrock，但未成功。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374338

items.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
items.content:
Bitcoin ETFs add $137M, pushing October back into the green
Bitcoin ETFs drew $424 million over three days, lifting October net inflows to $111 million despite a hawkish Federal Reserve decision and weaker crypto sentiment.
US-listed spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) extended their daily inflow streak to three on Wednesday, pushing October back into positive territory with two trading sessions left in the month.
Bitcoin (BTC) ETFs attracted $137 million on Wednesday, bringing their three-day inflows to roughly $424 million and October’s net inflows to $111 million, according to SoSoValue data.
October’s cumulative net flows remained negative through Tuesday, after nearly $774 million flowed out over the final two trading days of the previous week.
The Bitcoin ETF rebound coincided with the US Federal Reserve keeping its benchmark interest rate unchanged at a target range of 3.75% to 4% on Wednesday. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh warned that inflation remained above the central bank’s 2% target.
“With limited new direction from the Fed, Bitcoin’s near-term performance may depend more heavily on Treasury yields, dollar movements and broader risk sentiment,” Bitget analyst Lewis Huang said.
Bitcoin traded at $79,848 at the time of writing, down around 1% over the past 24 hours, according to CoinGecko. Market sentiment remained unchanged, with the Crypto Fear & Greed Index holding at 51, or “Neutral,” for a second consecutive day.
Meanwhile, Ether (ETH) ETFs continued to see withdrawals, shedding another $21 million on Wednesday and bringing October’s net outflows to $1.35 billion. Ether traded at $2,310, down 1.7% over the past 24 hours.
Related: Bitcoin price bounce rejected at 50-day trend line ahead of FOMC, earnings
items.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $137M, pushing October back into the green

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，据 HTX 行情数据，比特币现报 79,907.10 美元，24 小时下跌 1.25%；以太坊现报 2,313.12 美元，24 小时下跌 1.74%。

BlockBeats 注：资金费率（Funding rates）是加密货币交易平台为了保持合约价格与标的资产价格之间的平衡而设定的费率，通常适用于永续合约。它是多空交易者之间的资金交换机制，交易平台并不收取此费用，用于调整交易者持有合约的成本或收益，以使合约价格与标的资产价格保持接近。

当资金费率为 0.01% 时，表示基准费率。当资金费率大于 0.01% 时，代表市场普遍看多。当资金费率小于 0.005% 时，代表市场普遍看跌。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
Anthropic用Claude重写核心API，CPU用量降低40%至50%

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 平台工程负责人 Katelyn Lesse 在 Latent Space 访谈中透露，公司已经将 Messages API 从 Python 迁移至 Rust。改造后，API 服务的 CPU 用量据其估算减少约 40% 至 50%，首个 Token 的响应延迟改善约 10% 至 20%。

Messages API 是开发者调用 Claude 的主要接口。随着请求量不断增加，原来的 Python 单体服务越来越耗费 CPU，团队决定直接用 Rust 重写。但项目启动时，负责迁移的小组连一名 Rust 工程师都没有。

最终由 Claude 承担主要代码编写，人类工程师负责架构设计和验证。团队先搭建完整的 Rust 版本，让新旧系统处理相同请求，逐一比对输出，再逐步把正式流量切换过去。过程中也招聘了几名有 Rust 经验的工程师。

Lesse 表示，过去这种规模的迁移通常要拆成多个阶段，耗费数年。这次团队直接完成了整套 API 的迁移，并已于 9 月全面上线。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374329

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，美联储在周四如期将利率维持在当前水平。在最新政策声明中，该央行将对美国经济扩张的评估从 9 月份的「稳健」上调至「强劲」。美联储指出当前企业投资保持强劲，就业增长也与劳动力市场规模相匹配。

针对美联储的乐观经济预判，市场参与者提出了广泛质疑。随着经济增长动能有所减弱，部分观察人士认为，经济基本面只需出现轻微疲软，即可打破这一「强劲」前景。至于这种强劲表现究竟如何推动价格压力回落，目前仍不明朗。

在沃什的新闻发布会后，由于其未对未来政策行动做出明确承诺，市场对进一步加息的押注随之减少。在此背景下，此前几周趋平的 2 年期与 10 年期国债收益率利差再度走阔，最大达到 34.1 个基点。

长债端的猛烈抛售表明，投资者正在应对超越短期货币政策的复杂局面。持有 10 年期和 30 年期美债的投资者，在较长时间内面临通胀预期和利率变动的更大敞口。当不确定性增加时，他们会要求额外补偿来承担这种久期风险，从而推高收益率并压低债券价格。

items.content:
面壁开源两款OCR模型：1.3B负责识别，2B专门挑错

动察 Beating AI 快讯，面壁智能发布并开源 MiniCPM-OCR 系列。1.3B 的 MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 能识别手写文字、复杂表格、公式，以及拍歪、弯曲的文档。在六项 OCR 基准测试中，它有四项排名第一。RTX 5090 上的处理速度达到每秒 1.217 页，比 PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 快约 49%。

另一款 2B 模型 MiniCPM-OCR Jev 则专门负责挑错，通过对照原图检查 OCR 的结果，为文字、公式和表格分别打分。高分内容可以直接通过，存疑的再交给人工检查。它也能检查 GLM-OCR、PaddleOCR 等其他模型的输出，不需要更换原有的 OCR 系统。

这套设计瞄准的是 OCR 流程里最费人的一环：机器很快就能读完文档，工作人员却还得逐项检查有没有漏字、错行或数字识别错误。面壁在 900 个人工标注图块上的内部实验显示，当自动放行部分的准确率接近 100% 时，法律文书最多有 85% 的区域无需人工核对，财务票据为 56.2%，复杂文档为 35.1%。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374326

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
字节TRAE上线开发者个人助理：跨项目记住历史决策，还能同时调度多个任务

动察 Beating AI 快讯，字节跳动旗下 TRAE 今天上线开发者个人助理「TRAE宝」，主打跨项目长期记忆和多任务调度。开发者不再需要每次重新交代背景，也不用自己来回切换多个 AI 会话，协调不同任务。

TRAE 宝分为「全局助理」和「项目助理」。前者负责跨项目查找历史对话、任务和交付产物，提取过去采用的技术方案、约束和决策。比如要给新产品增加权限管理，它可以先找出以前做过的方案，判断哪些能够复用，再交给项目助理继续开发。

项目助理则负责具体执行。一个需求涉及前端、后端、测试和文档时，它可以拆解任务、安排并行开发，再根据依赖关系组织联调和验证。开发者也能继续布置其他任务，最后由助理统一汇报进度、问题和结果。

目前 TRAE 宝主要通过桌面端运行本地任务，支持接入微信、飞书远程下达指令。云端任务及独立移动端能力仍待后续开放。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
以太坊客户端发布安全更新，修复eMudhra证书漏洞，默认主网节点不受影响

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，印度证书颁发机构 eMudhra 的加密安全漏洞波及以太坊客户端 Teku 和 Besu。研究人员发现，eMudhra 旗下 8 个中间证书颁发机构的私钥因随机性不足而可能被推算，攻击者由此可能伪造证书，并诱骗未修复的软件信任恶意服务。

Teku 已发布 26.10.3 版本，Besu 已发布 26.10.2 版本，均在 Docker 镜像中移除了对相关证书的信任。若攻击者实施中间人攻击，可能诱骗部分验证者将区块手续费奖励发送至攻击者地址；在使用外部签名器的特定配置下，风险可能更高。

Teku 团队表示，默认配置的以太坊主网 Teku 节点不受影响，无需采取行动，目前尚无漏洞遭利用的报告。对于直接在主机上运行 Teku 或 Besu、未使用 Docker 的运营者，仅更新客户端可能不够，还需手动更新 Java 及其受信任证书列表。仍在使用已停止维护的 Java 26 的运营者，则需要迁移至 Java 25。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374316

美国犹他州对预测市场平台Kalshi及其两名联合创始人提起14项刑事指控

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，美国犹他州已对预测市场平台 Kalshi 及其两名联合创始人 Tarek Mansour、Luana Lopes Lara 提起 14 项刑事指控，包括 1 项涉嫌持续从事非法活动的重罪、12 项推广网络赌博的指控，以及 1 项轻罪赌博指控。

检方称，犹他州总检察长办公室的一名卧底人员于 9 月使用当地地址、电话号码和借记卡访问 Kalshi，并在平台上进行了 12 笔体育赛事投注，州方据此指控该平台在当地推广非法赌博。

此次刑事诉讼发生在犹他州总检察长提起民事诉讼数日后，后者要求阻止 Kalshi 接受犹他州居民投注，并追回其涉嫌在该州获得的利润。

Kalshi 此前主张，其体育赛事合约属于受美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）监管的金融衍生品，而非赌博，不应受州级监管。

不过，犹他州及其他多个州认为，预测市场平台仍须遵守州赌博法律。CFTC 也已起诉犹他州，主张此类合约应由联邦层面监管。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Your fridge could one day stake Ether, launch memecoins: CFTC chair
CFTC chair Mike Selig says autonomous AI agents could challenge financial rules built around human traders, and regulators need to adapt.
Commodity Futures Trading Commission Chair Michael Selig says it is “no longer science fiction” to imagine one’s refrigerator autonomously purchasing groceries with money earned from staking Ether — or even launching its own memecoin, raising questions about how regulators should oversee autonomous AI agents.
The colorful comment came during Selig’s remarks at the CFTC’s inaugural Frontier Forum in Washington, DC, on Wednesday, where he argued that regulators must adapt to a financial system where AI agents can hold assets and execute trades autonomously.
“We’re gathered here today to discuss a technology that’s rapidly transforming the financial markets. President Trump calls it ‘super intelligence,’ or SI, because ‘it’s not artificial.’ It’s as real as the printing press, the steam engine, and the internet,” he said.
The regulatory questions come as younger investors embrace AI tools for managing money. An eToro survey published in September found that 79% of US millennial investors and 77% of Gen Z investors already used or were open to using AI to select or adjust their investments, highlighting the potential reach of rules governing automated finance.
Selig says the CFTC’s regulatory framework was developed around “identifiable market participants” performing specific financial functions, but autonomous software is raising questions about how those rules apply.
“Consider an SI agent that identifies trading opportunities and executes transactions on behalf of a user,” said Selig.
“Does the developer of that agent become subject to registration? Who is liable if the agent goes rogue? How can regulators know who the agent, or suite of agents, is trading on behalf of? Do we need a new flavor of know-your-customer, maybe KYA or know-your-agent?”
AI could democratize trading, but bring new risks
Selig said AI could give smaller traders and businesses access to risk-management that was once reserved for larger institutions.
“SI can help process the vast amount of information significantly faster than human brain power and with greater accuracy,” he said.
But greater autonomy also comes with new risks. Agents could react unexpectedly to market conditions, while those using similar models could generate correlated trading behavior. The speed of autonomous transactions could also complicate market surveillance and risk management, he said.
Related: Coinbase CEO touts agentic finance as Base tops 100M AI payments
Animoca Brands Chairman Yat Siu recently raised a similar concern, telling Cointelegraph that a thousand people asking AI about the same trade could receive roughly the same answer. Users’ own knowledge and follow-up questions help shape more personalized strategies, he said.
Last year, the Bank of England’s Financial Policy Committee also warned that widespread use of similar models could amplify market shocks.
Crypto exchanges are already developing tools for autonomous trading.
Coinbase introduced Agentic Wallets in February, allowing agents to spend and trade within user-defined limits, while Binance launched AI Agent Skills in March to provide market data and tools for placing and managing spot orders.
Magazine: Agents can trade 24/7 — but Yat Siu warns you could lose access at any time
items.title: Your fridge could one day stake Ether, launch memecoins: CFTC chair

华尔街解读沃什讲话：暗示仍将加息，但幅度或有限

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，美联储 10 月 28 日以 10 比 2 的投票结果，将联邦基金利率目标区间维持在 3.75% 至 4% 不变。美联储理事 Lisa Cook 和克利夫兰联储主席 Beth Hammack 投反对票，主张立即加息。多家机构将主席沃什的讲话解读为仍可能进一步加息，但后续加息幅度或有限。

沃什在记者会上列举经济韧性：上半年 GDP 增速上修至 2.4%，第三季度增速追踪显示超过 3%，商业投资实现两位数增长，初请失业金人数接近历史低位。他认为，这为美联储专注于通胀目标提供了空间。对于金融条件，沃什承认 9 月加息后信贷条件有所收紧，但不愿将整体金融条件定性为「偏紧」。

道明证券美国首席宏观策略师 Oscar Muñoz 表示，仍预计美联储将在 12 月行动，认为不再加息的门槛很高。德意志银行高级美国经济学家 Brett Ryan 则指出，沃什对经济增长的乐观判断，以及拒绝将金融条件视为偏紧的表态，印证了美联储 9 月预测中年内再加息一次的路径。他认为，沃什是在没有明说的情况下传递进一步收紧的信号。

不过，沃什同时强调，经济增长更强并不必然意味着增长正在制造通胀，也不必然需要更高利率；美联储的目标并非阻碍经济运转或让人们失业。BNY Investments 首席经济学家 Vincent Reinhart 将其概括为：沃什在为进一步收紧做铺垫，但也在划定边界，即不需要收紧太多。

投票结构也受到关注。此前持续警告高通胀风险的达拉斯联储主席 Lorie Logan 和明尼阿波利斯联储主席 Neel Kashkari，此次支持维持利率不变。Nationwide 首席经济学家 Kathy Bostjancic 认为，两人支持暂缓行动，很可能是因为预期美联储将在 12 月再度加息。这属于其对投票动机的判断，并非两位官员已作出的政策承诺。

市场反应则显示，部分交易员认为讲话的鹰派程度不及预期。两年期美债收益率下行 4 个基点至 4.7%，长端收益率小幅走高。报道称，期货市场目前预期 12 月和明年 3 月各加息一次。沃什则强调，从现在到 12 月会议之间仍有一个「信息丰富的窗口期」，新的增长及通胀数据将为决策提供依据。

DeepSeek新版为何突然变强？外媒曝出Astra蒸馏内幕，梁文锋向竞争压力妥协

动察 Beating AI 快讯，DeepSeek 新版模型能力大涨，背后可能真有 Astra 的功劳。

The Information 援引多名直接知情人士称，DeepSeek 10 月 17 日更新的 V4.1-Flash-1017，以及月之暗面新发布的 Kimi K3.1 Pro，都在训练过程中大量利用了 OpenAI GPT-6 Astra 的输出进行蒸馏。

DeepSeek 新版在浏览器操作任务上的表现尤其突出。Browser Use 的 180 项真实网页任务测试中，它的得分从旧版的 70.9 提高到 75.0，接近 Astra 的 77.9。但每题模型调用成本仅 0.22 美元，Astra 则高达 10.77 美元，相差近 49 倍。

此前，Claude 一直是国内 AI 公司蒸馏的主要目标。但 Anthropic 最近两个月不断收紧防护，试图提取模型推理过程的难度大幅增加，国内实验室于是把目光转向了 Astra。

DeepSeek 创始人梁文锋原本不愿在 V4 研发中依赖蒸馏。但看到智谱 GLM 等国内竞争对手借助蒸馏取得进展后，最终向竞争压力妥协。

名义价值110亿美元比特币期权将于明日到期交割，交易员警惕中期选举前后波动加剧

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，据彭博社报道，名义价值约 110 亿美元比特币期权将于 10 月 30 日到期，占 Deribit 平台比特币期权未平仓规模约三分之一。交易员正警惕到期结算及 11 月 3 日美国中期选举前后可能加剧的价格波动。此次到期合约中，看涨期权多于看跌期权，行权价集中于 90,000、95,000 及 100,000 美元；随着比特币在 80,000 美元附近徘徊，这些高行权价合约很可能到期归零。

Tesseract Group 资产管理负责人 Adam Haeems 表示，约 70% 的到期期权 Gamma 集中在 75,000 至 82,000 美元区间。Gamma 反映价格变化对做市商对冲需求的影响。在 80,000 美元以下的行权价中，看跌期权数量超过看涨期权两倍。他强调，公开数据无法确定做市商持仓方向；若其持有期权空头，对冲操作可能加速比特币在 75,000 至 78,000 美元区间的下跌，而相反方向的头寸则可能缓冲跌势。

Orbit Markets 联创 Caroline Mauron 认为，更明显的波动可能出现在周五到期之后。持币并卖出期权的投资者通常会在旧合约到期后卖出新合约，但部分卖方可能等到中期选举结束后再行动。她表示，常规 Gamma 供给减少，可能使选举结果公布期间的价格波动加大。

选举结果还可能影响特朗普推进支持加密政策的能力。彭博 Market Pulse 调查显示，若共和党保住参众两院，受访者对比特币年底价格的预测中值为 90,800 美元；若民主党控制两院，则为 76,450 美元；若两党分别控制一院，则为 84,100 美元。

Wincent 高级主管 Paul Howard 表示，选举可能促使投资者买入更多接近当前价格的看跌期权，以防范进一步下跌。他预计，在过去一年波动率处于历史低位之后，11 月将出现明显回升，市场也会增加受益于价格波动的头寸。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Tampered Ledger wallets cost Singapore users $2.7M: Police
Police say at least two cases were reported as early as Sept. 10, nearly a month before the wider incident became public.
Singapore police say at least two cases involving tampered Ledger hardware wallets have been reported since Sept. 10, with combined losses of about 3.5 million Singapore dollars ($2.7 million), placing local reports almost a month before the wider incident became public.
In an advisory published Wednesday, the Singapore Police Force said preliminary investigations found malicious hardware components in Ledger wallets purchased from some retail stores in Singapore.
The disclosure adds both a local loss figure and an earlier reporting date to the incident, which surfaced publicly on Oct. 9 following reports of losses involving devices sold through CryptoBilis, an authorized Ledger reseller in Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines.
Days later, former Mt. Gox CEO Mark Karpelès said that a Ledger Flex purchased at Singapore’s airport contained a spy implant.
Another Ledger user claimed to have a tampered device bought from local IT retailer Challenger. The user said he was later sent a new device from Ledger.
On Oct. 13, Ledger said it has asked retailers in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Hong Kong to suspend sales of Ledger devices as investigations are ongoing.
Singapore police said it is in contact with Ledger, which is reviewing the affected cases, while police investigations are ongoing.
Related: Ledger’s early implant warnings deserved more action, Karpelès says
items.title: Tampered Ledger wallets cost Singapore users $2.7M: Police

Cognition获最高800亿美元估值报价，年化收入却只有Cursor约四分之一

动察 Beating AI 快讯，AI 编程公司 Cognition 收到新一轮融资要约，投资人给出的估值高达 700 亿至 800 亿美元，甚至超过 SpaceX 收购 Cursor 时 600 亿美元的隐含股权估值。

9 月 8 日，Cognition 刚以 480 亿美元估值融资超过 20 亿美元。短短七周，最高报价又提高了 67%。公司正考虑年底前再次融资，但尚未敲定。

Cognition 的核心产品 Devin，已经从辅助写代码发展到自主执行软件工程任务。去年收购 Windsurf 后，又补齐了 AI 代码编辑器和企业销售渠道。收购时 Windsurf 已有超过 350 家企业客户。Cognition 的年化收入从今年 5 月的 4.92 亿美元，增长到 9 月的超过 10 亿美元。客户包括英伟达、花旗和奔驰。

但与 Cursor 一比，估值还是贵了。Cursor 6 月的年化收入已达约 40 亿美元，是 Cognition 的近四倍。如今 Cognition 收到的报价反而更高。按 10 亿美元年化收入粗算，估值已相当于收入的 70 至 80 倍。

而且 Cursor 被 SpaceX 收购后，可以使用后者的 GPU 集群；Cognition 则每年花费数亿美元租用英伟达服务器，还要基于开源模型训练自己的编程模型，今年现金消耗可能高达 8 亿美元。

知情人士称，如果不计自研模型投入，Cognition 的自由现金流已接近盈亏平衡。偏偏这笔投入，正是它试图减少对 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 模型依赖的办法。

三星电子推迟股东回报计划，股价一度大跌6.6%

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，由于财报中缺乏新的股东回报计划令投资者感到失望，三星电子股价回吐早前涨幅，一度大跌 6.6%。三星电子表示，将在 1 月底宣布该计划。这与 SK 海力士形成了鲜明对比，后者周三不仅公布了亮眼的财报，还表示计划向股东返还约 450 亿美元的额外资金。此外，三星芯片业务的利润不及预期以及资本支出的扩大，也打击了市场对该公司的情绪。

eToro 分析师 Josh Gilbert 表示，让市场一直等到 1 月才能看到完整的回报计划，这在本该传出好消息的地方留下了一个缺口。三星今年还将资本支出上调了约 60%，因此，在它明确说明这笔意外之财将如何在新产能和股东之间分配之前，究竟有多少钱能真正回到投资者手中，是一个实实在在的问号。

Amont Partners 管理合伙人 Rob Li 表示，将股东回报的细节推迟到 1 月令人失望，这给了股票交易员在未来几个月将资金轮动到 SK 海力士或美光的借口，因为另外两家公司拥有更清晰的股东回报路径。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374278

谷歌Q3财报解读：云收入翻倍但搜索广告增长放缓、自由现金流缺口扩大，股价盘后大跌10%

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，谷歌母公司 Alphabet 公布 2026 年第三季度财报，营收约 1276 亿美元，同比增长 25%，低于 LSEG 预期的 1282 亿美元，股价盘后下跌约 10%。这份财报呈现的核心反差是：云业务增长加速，但搜索变现转换与现金回收仍面临压力。

谷歌云是主要亮点：收入 307.09 亿美元，同比增长 103%；营业利润 111.21 亿美元，约为去年同期的 3.1 倍，分部营业利润率由 23.7% 升至 36.2%。公司指出，企业 AI 基础设施、AI 解决方案及 TPU 系统销售均贡献增长。从分部数据看，增长已体现为营业利润提升，但不能将全部云收入等同于 AI 收入。

搜索端则出现使用量与变现节奏的差异。搜索查询量同比增速创五年新高；同期搜索及其他收入增长 12% 至 633.5 亿美元，但广告总收入约 820 亿美元，低于预期 834 亿美元。首席商务官 Philipp Schindler 解释：汇率是搜索收入增速较上季放缓的首要因素，部分行业广告支出变化及 AI Mode 较低的变现水平也有影响，公司正扩大 AI 搜索广告投放。

现金流方面，本季经营现金流 422.90 亿美元，资本开支 513.55 亿美元，自由现金流约为负 90.7 亿美元，连续第二季度为负，缺口较上季约 59 亿美元扩大。首席财务官同时指出，TPU 库存增加及 52 亿美元欧盟罚款付款也影响当季现金流，因此不能将全部缺口简单归为新增 AI 资本开支。

每股盈利下滑同样需要区分经营与投资因素。公司营业利润同比增长 30% 至 405.76 亿美元，但 GAAP 每股盈利降至 2.12 美元，受到 SpaceX 投资未实现亏损影响。按路透社披露的调整后口径，每股盈利为 2.67 美元，仍低于 3.02 美元预期，意味着业绩落差也不能全部用投资亏损解释。

公司维持 2026 年 1950 亿至 2050 亿美元资本开支指引，预计 2027 年将显著增加，尚未披露具体金额。管理层同时提示，第四季度扩大第三方算力使用将使云业务近期利润率承压，TPU 备货也将继续影响自由现金流。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374276

甲骨文股价大涨超10%，投资者日指引缓解AI烧钱担忧，近期密集宣布AI合作

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，据 BIT 股票平台数据显示，甲骨文（ORCL）股价收盘大涨约 11%，报 144 美元附近，单日市值增加超过 400 亿美元，创下 5 月以来最大单日涨幅，盘中一度冲高超 13%。

推动此次股价大涨的直接催化剂，是甲骨文在当日投资者日活动上给出的财务指引。公司提供了更清晰的现金流路径，有效缓解了市场对「AI 建设持续烧钱、债务高企」的核心担忧。公司预计自由现金流将在下一财年（FY2028）下半年转正，并在 FY2029 达到约 300 亿美元；资本开支预计在 FY2027 至 2028 年见顶后开始下降。

此外，从现在到 2030 财年，公司的额外融资（股票加债务）上限被锁定在 200 亿美元。甲骨文还重申了长期财务目标：2030 财年营收至少 2250 亿美元，调整后营业利润率不低于 40%，调整后 EPS 不低于 21 美元，并重申了 FY2027 营收至少 900 亿美元、调整后 EPS 8.10 美元的预期。这些具体数字直接回应了投资者最关心的问题，即大规模数据中心建设能否尽快实现「自我造血」，指引公布后股价迅速拉升。

除了财务指引，甲骨文在本周 Oracle AI World 大会期间也密集宣布了多项合作，进一步强化了其云基础设施（OCI）作为多芯片、多生态 AI 平台的定位。具体包括与 OpenAI 扩大合作，将甲骨文企业应用和数据接入 ChatGPT，并推出多款基于 OpenAI 模型的新产品；与英伟达扩大合作，使 OCI Superclusters 采用最新的 Vera Rubin 系统，规模达到「多吉瓦级别」；与谷歌达成合作，OCI 将成为谷歌之外首家提供 Google TPU 的超大规模云服务商（2027 年起）。

此外，甲骨文还扩大了与英特尔、Cerebras 以及 Snowflake 的合作。这些举措不仅丰富了 OCI 的硬件选择，降低了对单一供应商的依赖，还将企业应用、数据和 AI 更紧密地结合，有利于吸引更多 AI 训练和推理负载。

总体来看，甲骨文的投资者日把中长期现金流和融资路径讲得更加清晰，叠加近期密集落地的 AI 合作，共同推动了这次显著反弹。后续市场将继续关注其资本开支节奏、订单转化进度以及现金流是否按计划转正。

⚡️分析师解读美联储10月决议：新规透露重大制度转向信号，按兵不动背后是鹰派内部的「耐心共识」

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，北京时间今日凌晨，美联储宣布 10 月议息会议按兵不动，决议以 10 比 2 获得通过（2 位联储主席主张加息 25 个基点）。与 9 月相比，本次声明将经济评价从「稳健」上调至「强劲」，删除了「当次政策行动将帮助通胀回归 2% 目标」的表述，转而强调需积累更多信息。

分析师 @qinbafrank 在社交媒体上发文表示，美联储此次动作透露出重大的制度转向信号。主席沃什在发布会上宣布了重大的机制变化：从 2027 年起，美联储将有一次会议专注于宏观货币政策战略，不进行利率投票也不发布声明；2028 年此类战略会议将增至两次，政策会议相应减至六次。结合年底将陆续出结果的五个工作组，分析师认为，减少利率决议次数是更大范围联储制度转向的开始。

在基本面方面，沃什对经济表示乐观，指出上半年 GDP 增速上修至 2.4%，且就业情况「相当积极」。在金融环境上，沃什承认已出现一定程度收紧迹象，并承认 AI 基础设施投资受利率上升影响。但沃什拒绝将金融条件整体定性为「紧张」，认为这有助于实现价格稳定。

对于沃什的整体表态，该分析师认为其并未明确解释此次不加息的具体原因，仅表示要收集更多信息。沃什「既不愿意也无法称金融状况很紧」的表述略显鹰派，但他同时强调金融状况正在变紧，对冲了上述论调。总体而言，@qinbafrank 认为沃什的态度偏中性，尚未达到「鹰派暂停」的强度；这次暂停并非鸽派转向，而是鹰派内部的「耐心共识」。

此外，分析师强调，沃什正在建立新的沟通框架，即反对前瞻指引、不提交点阵图、不预判会议结果。这释放出美联储刻意收窄对金融市场短期干预的信号，更加强调数据依赖。对于 12 月是否加息，@qinbafrank 认为，这首先取决于通胀数据，而通胀又受中东局势影响，基于当下数据决策的沃什很难提前给出明确预期。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
黑客声称经Okta泄露美土安全部逾4万员工信息，DDoSecrets已公开

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，据 TechCrunch 报道，一名自称「Department of Peace」的黑客声称从美国国土安全部（DHS）使用的 Okta 单点登录系统获取大量员工数据，并由数据透明组织 Distributed Denial of Secrets（DDoSecrets）于周三以「Icepick」数据集公开发布。泄露记录逾 4 万条，约占 DHS 约 22 万雇员规模的五分之一，涉及姓名、职务、工作邮箱、手机号与办公地点，并关联内部系统权限等信息；其中约 2.1 万条为海关与边境保护局（CBP）人员，另有约 1 万条涉及移民与海关执法局（ICE）及其国土安全调查局（HSI），网络安全与基础设施安全局（CISA）相关记录接近 1000 条。

TechCrunch 称已核验部分数据真实性，记录时间戳显示数据约于 8 月中旬被导出；黑客还将数据提供给记者兼黑客 maia arson crimew，再转交 DDoSecrets。Okta 回应称自身系统与数据未被入侵；国土安全部发言人暂未回复置评请求。报道指，此事是近一个月内第三起引发关注的美国政府数据泄露事件，此前联邦调查局人员档案与五角大楼人事数据也曾遭窃。

【Solidus Labs：Hyperliquid 原油永续合约此前出现超 1.7 亿美元异常订单，涉嫌幌骗交易】

Foresight News 消息，据彭博社报道，Solidus Labs 分析发现，3 月 8 日至 10 日国际油价因伊朗战争剧烈波动期间，某交易者通过 Hyperliquid 上的两个账户提交超 1.7 亿美元的异常订单，涉嫌通过「幌骗交易」（Spoofing）操纵原油永续合约价格。该交易者频繁在订单簿一侧挂出并撤销大额订单，同时在另一侧执行交易，撤单金额与反向成交金额之比约为 30:1，三天内获利约 11.9 万美元。其中 3 月 9 日的一次交易中，该交易者短时间内撤销约 1700 万美元卖单，同时执行约 42.5 万美元买单。相关活动主要集中于 Brent 原油永续合约，也涉及 WTI 原油及天然气合约。Solidus 认为，这些行为符合幌骗交易特征，但尚无法证实其操纵意图。Hyperliquid Labs 回应称，平台所有订单、撤单及交易记录均公开记录于区块链，可供市场参与者和监管机构审查。

美国司法部正调查英伟达收购Hugging Face

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，据路透社报道，美国司法部已就英伟达收购开源 AI 模型平台 Hugging Face 对人工智能竞争的影响，以及英伟达的运营方式展开调查。路透援引两名知情人士称，司法部官员询问这笔约 129 亿美元的交易，是否会让英伟达掌控 AI 领域的关键分发枢纽，以及英伟达能否借 Hugging Face 伤害竞争对手或将其用作谈判筹码；官员还就 Hugging Face 的竞争方提出了问题。

知情人士称，司法部近期调查范围较广，涵盖英伟达的收购与投资、销售惯例，以及是否对客户施压等。该调查自拜登政府时期启动，并延续至特朗普政府；路透称未见特朗普总统介入迹象。另据知情人士，司法部还审视英伟达在获得芯片初创公司 Groq 技术许可并吸纳核心工程师后，是否向同时采购网络设备与 Groq 处理器的客户分配更多 AI 芯片；2025 年 12 月收购的 SchedMD，以及 Run:ai 收购，也曾进入调查视野。路透强调，调查本身不等于违法证据，也未必走向诉讼。英伟达上月宣布收购 Hugging Face 时表示，该平台将继续支持与各类半导体、云与 AI 厂商的合作，并对整个 AI 生态保持开放；交易预计明年上半年完成。

items.content:
Fed’s hawkish rate hold keeps pressure on Bitcoin: Analysts
Traders are pricing in a 78% chance of a December rate hike, while analysts say Treasury yields, the US dollar and upcoming inflation data could determine Bitcoin’s next move.
Bitcoin could face further headwinds after the US Federal Reserve held interest rates steady while signaling continued concern about inflation, according to market analysts.
The Fed voted 10-2 Wednesday to maintain its benchmark interest rate at 3.75% to 4%, with Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack favoring a quarter-point increase.
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh acknowledged that inflation remained above the central bank’s 2% target.
“Americans… are still dealing with inflation that has been running above the Committee’s objective for close to 6 years. It’s our responsibility to get inflation down,” he said.
Iggy Ioppe, chief investment officer at tokenization platform Theo, said the decision itself was widely expected, but investors had not fully anticipated the Fed’s hawkish messaging.
“Markets had the hold priced, but not the hawkish tone,” he said in comments sent to Cointelegraph.
There are expectations that the Fed will raise rates in its Dec. 8-9 meeting, and again next year.
CME FedWatch data showed traders assigning a 78.4% probability to a quarter-point increase by December and a 67.3% probability of at least a quarter-point increase by March, as of Wednesday.
Warsh declined to say whether the Fed would raise rates at the end of the year.
“A lot of things can happen, so I’m not going to be able to share with you my musings about what happens when this group gets together six weeks from now,” he said during a press conference.
At elevated interest rates, Bitcoin has to “compete with” a risk-free rate near 4%, said Ioppe.
Related: Bitcoin price bounce rejected at 50-day trend line ahead of FOMC, earnings
However, Bitget analyst Lewis Huang said Bitcoin’s next move could depend less on the Fed’s decision itself than on Treasury yields, the US dollar and broader investor sentiment.
“With limited new direction from the Fed, Bitcoin’s near-term performance may depend more heavily on Treasury yields, dollar movements and broader risk sentiment,” he said.
Analysts, including Huang, are now looking to Thursday’s personal consumption expenditures inflation report and earnings from major technology companies for clues about the direction of risk assets.
Sygnum Bank chief investment officer Fabian Dori agreed, adding that “the next couple of days promise more excitement” with Thursday’s release of PCE inflation data.
“Various Mag 7 companies reporting earnings this week will help clarify whether AI capex is turning into revenues. Following these short-term catalysts, broader liquidity and financial conditions are likely to shape the path towards the December decision,” he added.
Magazine: Crypto could outperform AI stocks: Wall Street veteran Jordi Visser

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，韩股三星电子于今日公布其 2026 年第三季度正式财报。数据显示，公司当季营收录得 195.3 万亿韩元，略高于此前公布的初步数据；第三季度营业利润为 107.4 万亿韩元。不过，公司当季净利润为 75.2 万亿韩元，不及市场预期的 83.6 万亿韩元。财报公布后，三星电子股价短线下挫，随后微幅回升，现涨 0.2%。

从业务部门来看，半导体业务依然是绝对的业绩引擎。第三季度芯片部门营业利润高达 106.5 万亿韩元，几乎包揽了全公司的利润。其中，晶圆代工业务收入大幅增长，公司预计第四季度该业务收入将实现两位数增长。此外，显示器业务也保持了稳健的盈利，录得营业利润 1.1 万亿韩元。相比之下，移动部门则表现疲软，第三季度录得营业亏损 6000 亿韩元。

在股东回报方面，三星电子宣布第三季度将派发每股 4601 韩元的股息，总派息规模达 30 万亿韩元。展望未来，三星管理层对半导体市场持乐观态度，预计第四季度存储芯片需求将继续扩大，并预警明年芯片供应短缺的状况将进一步加剧。

微软Q3财报电话会：预计云业务增速高于市场预期，本季仍保持正自由现金流

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，微软在公布 2026 年第三季度财报后举行电话会。公司当季营收 923 亿美元，同比增长 19%，经调整后每股收益 4.89 美元，均超出市场预期。Microsoft Cloud 营收达到 639 亿美元，同比增长 30%，Azure 营收 331.7 亿美元，同比增长 48%。财报公布后，股价在盘后交易中上涨约 4%。

在电话会上，首席执行官萨提亚·纳德拉（Satya Nadella）表示，本季是财年的一个强劲开局。他指出，公司正聚焦三件事：设计 AI 赋能人、确保每个组织对自己的学习拥有主权，以及构建信任与控制以确保智能体（agent）的安全。纳德拉还介绍了 Copilot 的最新重大更新，将 Chat、Cowork、Autopilot 和 Code 整合为统一体验，并提到公司在自研模型方面持续取得进展。

首席财务官艾米·胡德（Amy Hood）在电话会上表示，业绩在营收、经营利润和每股收益上均超出预期，主要受 Microsoft Cloud 强劲需求推动。当季资本开支为 452 亿美元，部分原因是预期在本季交付的第三方算力有所延迟。大约四分之三的资本开支用于短期资产，主要包括 CPU 和 GPU，以及更高的内存与存储成本。商业剩余履约义务增长 73% 至 6770 亿美元。

在展望方面，管理层给出下一季度营收指引为 960 亿至 971 亿美元，并预计 Azure 增速（恒定汇率）将达到 49% 至 50%，高于市场预期。胡德表示，客户需求仍超过供给。下一季度资本开支预计将超过 500 亿美元；受第三方算力交付延迟影响，2026 日历年资本开支预计约 1700 亿美元，并在财年下半年进一步加速。公司同时预计 Microsoft Cloud 毛利率约 65%，因 Azure 业务占比提升而有所承压。

与部分同行不同，微软本季仍保持正自由现金流（约 186 亿美元），尽管同比有所下降。胡德表示，公司对资本开支回报有信心，并拥有多种融资灵活性。

市场对本季业绩反应积极。投资者认为，在高额 AI 投入背景下，Azure 仍实现加速增长且指引上修，一定程度缓解了对资本开支回报节奏的担忧。不过，管理层也承认算力供给仍紧张，资本开支在下半年将继续提升，相关投入对毛利率和现金流的影响仍是后续关注重点。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374250
items.title: 微软Q3财报电话会：预计云业务增速高于市场预期，本季仍保持正自由现金流

美股光模块龙头Marvell拟收购光芯片龙头Lumentum

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，据彭博社援引知情人士报道称，美股芯片公司 Marvell Technology（MRVL）正与数据中心光学厂商 Lumentum Holdings（LITE）就收购事宜进行高级谈判。报道称，交易最早可能于下周宣布，但谈判仍处于非公开阶段。

消息传出后，Lumentum 盘后股价上涨约 11%，按当时价格测算公司市值约 910 亿美元；Marvell 盘后跌超 8%。Lumentum 主要生产用于通信网络与数据中心的光学组件，AI 算力负载推高高速数据传输需求后，该赛道受到更多资金关注。Marvell 最新财季现金及现金等价物约 39.2 亿美元。Bernstein 分析师指出，潜在交易体量将考验融资与整合能力，且很难完全以现金完成。

Marvell 受益于定制 AI 芯片与网络产品需求，今年以来股价接近翻两番。此次收购若落地，将进一步推进其在 AI 基础设施光学技术上的布局；公司去年底曾宣布以 32.5 亿美元收购光子技术公司 Celestial AI。本月早些时候，Marvell 还将 2028 财年营收预期从 150 亿美元上调至 200 亿美元，理由是定制 AI 芯片与数据中心网络产品需求强劲。

谷歌财报电话会：Gemini月活用户达10亿，但预计明年资本开支将大幅增加

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 29 日，谷歌母公司 Alphabet 于今日凌晨在公布 2026 年第三季度财报后举行电话会。公司当季营收达 1276 亿美元，同比增长 25%，年化营收运行率已达 5000 亿美元，Google Cloud 营收同比增长 103% 至 307 亿美元。不过营收与利润均略低于华尔街预期，财报公布后股价在盘后交易中下跌约 9% 至 10%。

在电话会上，首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊（Sundar Pichai）表示，公司凭借全栈 AI 策略，正推动各业务线保持势头。他指出，AI 投入提升了搜索业务的使用量和查询增长，同比查询增长率创近五年来新高，其中商业查询增长同样强劲。公司正在打造覆盖 AI Overviews、AI Mode 与传统搜索的无缝体验，用户查询呈现更长、更个性化、更多模态的特征。

皮查伊还介绍了 AI 产品进展：Gemini 应用月活用户已达 10 亿，成为 Google 历史上增长最快的产品；第一方模型 API 处理量达到每分钟近 320 亿 tokens，环比增长 40%，较一年前提升超四倍。当天公司正式宣布推出新一代前沿模型 Gemini 4 Carbon，在多项评测中表现领先，尤其在网络安全和长时程任务能力上有明显进步。此前两周推出的 Gemini 4 Argon 也展现出快速采用态势。此外，公司还公布了世界模型 Genie 4 等进展。

分业务方面，管理层提到 Google Services 营收增长 11% 至 963 亿美元，其中搜索及其他广告收入同比增长 12%，YouTube 广告收入增长约 9% 至 112 亿美元，YouTube Music 与 Premium 订阅用户（含试用）已超过 1.5 亿。云业务的高速增长主要来自企业对 AI 基础设施、AI 解决方案以及 TPU 系统的强劲需求。

尽管管理层语气积极，盈利与现金流表现仍受到关注。当季归属于普通股股东的净利润为 262 亿美元，同比下降，主要受权益证券投资亏损影响（当季相关损失约 87 亿美元）。经营利润同比增长 30% 至 406 亿美元，经营利润率提升至 31.8%，但自由现金流转为负值。

资本开支维持高位，首席财务官 Anat Ashkenazi 表示，公司预计 2027 年资本开支将大幅增加（「increase significantly」）。同时，公司维持了 2026 年全年资本开支指引不变，仍为 1950 亿至 2050 亿美元区间。

皮查伊在发言中表示，公司对长期需求充满信心，正加快产能建设，并预计未来 12 个月模型迭代与产品落地速度将进一步加快。Waymo 等其他业务也持续推进，自动驾驶里程已超过 3 亿英里。市场反应则更为谨慎。投资者一方面认可云业务的高速增长和 AI 对搜索的拉动作用，另一方面对略低于预期的营收与利润、高额资本开支以及自由现金流承压表示担忧。电话会上管理层对 AI 前景的乐观表述，并未完全打消市场对短期投入回报节奏的疑虑。
