items.author: Aaron Wise
items.content:
Innodata, a trendy AI stock that hit a $1 billion market cap in the past two years of AI euphoria, crashed by over 25% yesterday after it fired 550 employees.
The drastic cut spooked investors that the company might have lost its most important customer. Indeed, termination emails blamed the wind-down of a business assignment from a customer.
Investors sold down the market cap of INOD — common shares that trade on the Nasdaq despite the company’s substantial overseas presence — by $500 million within a single trading session.
By the close of trading yesterday, Innodata had erased all market cap gains its shareholders earned since November 11, 2024.
Innodata fired approximately 550 workers in India this week, and made additional layoffs in the Philippines. On Tuesday, shares in the data labeling supplier collapsed on seven times their average trading volume.
Yesterday was the stock’s worst performance since February 15, 2024 when a Wolfpack Research short-selling report preceded a single day crash of 30%.
The company is one of the AI industry’s small-cap winners. Indeed, as recently as 2020, it was a penny stock.
Today, the New Jersey-headquartered company labels data and safety tests for AI labs.
It last reported 10,107 employees as of December 31, 2025, and has reported a staggering 12 consecutive quarters of year-over-year revenue growth.
Even after yesterday’s crash, the company was worth over $1.5 billion.
What started as an ordinary Monday for workers devolved into a purge. According to local reports, workers logged-in on October 26, layoff rumors spread by lunchtime, and office IDs were deactivated by the afternoon.
Read more: Meta’s AI bond just hit a record low as its stock soared
Two customers supplied 70% of Innodata’s Q2 revenue
The company’s quarterly report disclosed that the project work is “primarily at-will,” and that customers can “reduce, delay or cancel projects” at any time.
No Form 8-K landed on the SEC’s filing system by the evening of the layoffs.
According to the company’s second quarterly earnings report, its largest customer supplied roughly 37% of revenue for the three months ended June 30, 2026. Its next-biggest customer supplied 34% for those three months.
With that level of concentration, the missing client name certainly mattered to investors yesterday.
Whoever the ramped-down customer is, speculators have already picked a suspect. Predictions on X centered on Meta, which Hunterbrook Media reported in September was likely Innodata’s largest customer.
The official answer could arrive at any time via a press release of 8-K filing. As another opportunity to publicly clarify, Innodata reports third quarter 2026 results on November 5.

items.content:
In brief
- JPMorgan Chase, Coca-Cola, Dell, AMD, Adobe, Applied Materials, and Sandisk objected to trading of their shares on OKXICE TSV, according to its Oct. 27 notice.
- That brings the total to 33 objecting issuers, up from nine on Oct. 15.
- Under the SEC’s innovation exemption, a timely objection bars the venue from listing a third-party tokenized version of a company’s stock, though other venues aren’t affected.
The pushback against OKX and ICE’s tokenized stock venue now includes the biggest bank in the U.S.
JPMorgan Chase, Coca-Cola, and Dell Technologies are among seven companies added to OKXICE TSV’s list of objecting issuers in a notice dated Tuesday. Advanced Micro Devices, Adobe, Applied Materials, and Sandisk round out the group. The additions bring the total to 33, up from 26 a day earlier.
The list has grown quickly. It stood at nine on Oct. 15, 16 on Oct. 19, and 22 on Oct. 23. Earlier objectors include Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo, Intel, and Oracle. JPMorgan is the third major bank to object, after Goldman and Wells Fargo.
Under the SEC’s innovation exemption, which the agency unveiled in September after the Clarity Act stalled in the Senate, a venue must notify a company before offering a version of its shares tokenized by an unaffiliated third party. If the company objects in writing within 30 days, the venue can’t make that stock available for trading, according to the SEC’s order. The objection applies only to that venue. The notices haven’t disclosed the companies’ reasons.
OKXICE’s original Oct. 4 notice proposed 63 tokenized stocks from 62 companies, and several objectors, including Wells Fargo and Arm, weren’t on that initial roster. Some of the biggest names, including Nvidia, Tesla, Apple, and Amazon, haven’t objected so far.
OKXICE TSV, a 50-50 joint venture between NYSE owner Intercontinental Exchange and OKX’s U.S. holding company, plans to let approved users trade tokenized U.S. stocks 24/7. Trades would run through permissioned Uniswap v4 pools on OKX’s XLayer blockchain, paired with stablecoins such as USDC. Earlier notices warned that it’s uncertain whether tokenized shares in self-custodied wallets would be covered by the Securities Investor Protection Corporation if the tokenizer’s broker-dealer failed.
OKX and ICE first teamed up on tokenized securities earlier this year before announcing the 24/7 venue this month. Nasdaq, which won SEC approval for its own tokenized securities pilot, has said it will opt its shares out of the exemption.

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 28 日，资产管理巨头太平洋投资管理公司（Pimco）曾在 2025 年大举参与 AI 数据中心债务融资，如今通过提前出售部分持仓、进行利率对冲及放弃后续部分交易，成功规避了 AI 债券市场回调带来的部分损失，并实现盈利。

Pimco 此前分别参与 Meta 路易斯安那州数据中心项目约 180 亿美元的债务融资，以及 Oracle 密歇根州数据中心项目约 100 亿美元的融资。文件显示，该机构目前持有的两笔相关债务头寸均较此前减少约 50%。其中，Pimco 在买入 Meta 相关债券约 6 至 8 个月后，出售了约 30 亿美元债券，当时价格已高于面值；Oracle 相关债券价格则从发行时的 98.7 美分跌至约 88 美分。

随着 AI 基础设施融资规模持续扩大，Pimco 近期也更加谨慎，先后放弃参与博通与 Anthropic 相关的大型债务交易、软银约 110 亿美元垃圾债发行及部分 Oracle 数据中心贷款。不过，该机构仍参与了 SpaceX 一笔大型融资，认购约 40 亿美元债务，用于支持其 AI 业务扩张。（彭博社）

items.content:
⚡️「大空头」Michael Burry：A社招股书揭示AI热潮存在「灾难性脆弱」的系统性风险

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 28 日，「大空头」原型人物 Michael Burry 通过其 Substack 账号表示，Anthropic 刚公开的 IPO 招股说明书（S-1）揭示了整个 AI 热潮（而非仅 Anthropic 一家）存在灾难性脆弱的系统性风险。其主要理由如下：

1、巨额计算力承诺：Anthropic 已签署约 5370 亿美元的计算力/基础设施购买与租赁协议（主要来自 Amazon、Google/Alphabet、Microsoft、Broadcom 等），待定交易（含与 SpaceXAI 等）可能再增加数百亿美元，总规模有望接近 8000 亿美元。这大约相当于其当前年化营收运行率（约 650 亿美元）的 12 倍，也远超 trailing 12 个月收入的 20 倍。⁠

2、循环与互联融资结构：超算巨头同时扮演 Anthropic 的「贷款人、供应商、渠道商和股东」多重角色。融资安排简直「华丽而大胆」（garish and audacious）。这种高度互联在上行周期看起来像安全网，但一旦增长暂停或下行，整个生态会变得极度脆弱。他将其类比为互联网泡沫时期的供应商融资。

3、增长已在放缓 + 成本加速：季度营收增速从上一季的约 144% 降至约 46%，而计算成本却大幅上升（约 78%）。Michael Burry 指出 S-1 数据主要截至 6 月 30 日，未能充分反映 Q3 及之后开发者生态的变化，且「没有什么能改变我的整体观点」。

Michael Burry 认为 Anthropic 这套结构在 AI 持续高速增长时可以运转，但任何明显放缓都可能引发连锁反应甚至崩溃。他强调风险在于系统的「循环性与连接性」，而非单纯技术问题。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374208

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 28 日，Circle 向美国证券交易委员会提交了关于其拟议的加密资产监管条例的意见。Circle 支持该提案的目标，即在明确的规则下促进创新，同时维护美国资本市场的优势，包括透明度、投资者保护、市场诚信、流动性和效率。Circle 还建议，加密资产监管条例应与 GENIUS 法案保持一致。鉴于支付稳定币正日益成为链上资本形成的重要对价和结算资产，Circle 请求美国证券交易委员会（SEC）澄清符合 GENIUS 法案规定的支付稳定币如何用于这些用途。

该信函进一步要求委员会澄清，符合条件的支付稳定币在拟议规则 302（b）中构成「现金」，应获得适当的美元估值处理，并符合相应的会计和客户准备金处理条件。Circle 还建议，在采取客观保障措施的前提下，将目前符合 GENIUS 规定的支付稳定币的 2% 经纪商折扣降至零。

最后，Circle 请求 SEC 澄清，网络投入运行后提供的技术服务（包括维护已知的验证节点集）不属于必要的管理工作。为技术路线图设立安全港规则，将允许发行方继续维护和改进已运行的网络，而不会无意中重新启动相关分析。

items.author: Simon Willison
items.content:
I've written before about how November 2025 was an inflection point for coding agents - the point where Opus 4.5 and GPT-5.1 crossed a tipping point that meant their respective coding agents became reliable daily drivers for software engineers. I think we've reached a new inflection point in October 2026, and this time it's for vibe coding computer games.

  • Tree Appreciator
  • Emberwick
  • Battle Drones
  • Pumpkin Farmer, aka Quarter Sun Cove
  • Four times as insulting
  • What happens if someone actually puts the work in?
  • You should build a game!

Claude Opus 5.5 in particular exhibits meaningful improvements in several areas needed to build a compelling game:

  • 3D modeling
  • Music generation (see Scrimshaw Jukebox)
  • Game design (!)

That last one is particularly important. Models have been able to create something that looks like a game for quite a while now, as seen in my previous experiments. The challenge has been getting to a game that's actually fun to play.

Game design is a deep subject area. I won't pretend to be well versed in it - I know enough to have respect for it as a craft. Creating a novel, compelling gameplay loop which challenges players at the right level and provides a satisfying learning curve is a fine art. I didn't think the models could do it.

Then I tried telling Claude Opus 5.5 to "Make it a LOT more fun"... and it did.

In the past few weeks I've vibe coded (in the classic sense of the term - no looking at the code at all) four games that I've genuinely enjoyed playing.

I attended Foo Camp in Berkeley over the weekend and met several people who were having similar experiences. Building games that play well is shockingly easy now. The new challenge is coming up with concepts for games that are novel and delightful and that wouldn't exist without AI assistance.

I haven't done an exhaustive study, but my current impression is that GPT-6 Astra isn't quite there yet. It can absolutely build a game, but its sense of fun doesn't match that of Opus 5.5. I expect OpenAI will get there by the end of the year.

Here are the four game projects that have convinced me that the models are now capable of producing fun games with very little guidance. All four are built in HTML and JavaScript and run entirely in the browser.

Tree Appreciator

The smallest game I found to be genuinely delightful is Tree Appreciator. I used the regular Claude chat interface for this - it didn't even need Claude Code.

I built this on a whim while we were driving along Skyline Boulevard looking at trees. My prompt was:

Build a three js game called "Tree appreciator" - it shows you two algorithmically generated trees and the game mechanics is about appreciating the differences between them. Think hard about how to make sure it is both fun and beautiful.

I've found that telling models to use three.js works really well. Claude doesn't have its own image generation model but is capable of building full-color 3D models that look and feel excellent.

This game required no iteration or follow-up prompting at all - I got the game in a single shot. It gave me back a charming little mobile-friendly spot-the-difference game. You can play that here. Here's the chat transcript that built it.

It's pleasingly relaxing. The graphics are fun, and collecting trees that you have completed in a "herbarium" provides a nice, cosy sense of accomplishment.

Emberwick

This was a more ambitious project that I again built using regular Claude chat. I started out by building an experimental prototype of an engine for a top-down fantasy RPG:

Build a demo game engine three.js which is a top down (but at an angle) RPG - the player gets to move through the world with one or two companions. Create a fantasy village setting that demonstrates walking around outside and then shows how when the player enters a building the wall between the player and the camera goes transparent so the user can see what is happening

Add some NPCs and plenty of furniture and different types of building some with an upstairs - be creative, make it look great

Here's that first version. It worked really well!

I was inspired to increase my ambitions:

Make it not so flat - the buildings are great but the landscape itself is completely flat at the moment, fix that

Add basements to two of the buildings with a tunnel system joining them below the village

Add the start of a rocky mountain on one side of the village containing a cave with a sleeping troll

Here's that version.

When that produced a good result, I decided to push it all the way:

Now turn this into an actual game - quadruple the size of the playable area, introduce fun game mechanics, add a plot that isn't too cliche, some twists, a magic system, make it really good

We're back to prompts like "make it really good" here! Asking for a plot that "isn't too cliche" seemed to work too - it's a bit cliché, but still novel enough that I enjoyed following the story.

Unlike Tree Appreciator, this took quite a bit of additional playtesting and prompting to get to a finished version. This was mainly due to gameplay problems - things like a character not being in the right place to complete a quest because a different story element had caused them to move to another location.

Here's that final game. It has a full story that takes about 15 minutes to play through.

There's even an experimental level editor if you want to drop in your own houses, furniture, and landscape features.

Once it was all working (and I'd iterated through some gameplay bugs), I played it through from start to finish and found myself emotionally affected by the ending! I'm somewhat embarrassed by this, because everything in this game - the graphics, the plot, the characters, the music, the dialog - came from the model. My creative input was pretty much just "it's a fantasy village and there's a troll asleep in a cave".

Here's the full shared Claude chat in which I built this game.

I also fed that same initial sequence of prompts through ChatGPT GPT-6 Pro. Here's the transcript and the finished game for comparison. It looks great, but I don't think it plays nearly as well.

Battle Drones

This is by far my most successful project, which I wrote about last week. It's a Command & Conquer-style Real-Time Strategy game where two robot armies (or four as of Saturday) build units, harvest scrap, and battle over territory.

This is also the project that convinced me that Opus 5.5 knows what "fun" is.

The first versions were built back in July using Claude Fable 5. It got me to a workable 2D Command & Conquer-style game, but it wasn't great to play.

I prompted Opus 5.5 to "Make it a LOT more fun" and then later to "Port this game to three.js" and the game was transformed. There's a blow-by-blow account (prompts included) in my write-up.

Today, Battle Drones has 2-4 player multiplayer (via a vibe coded WebSockets relay server), medals, replays, seven maps, a random map generator, and a set of "mutators" that add variants of the rules.

It also lets different LLMs play against each other, using a mode where the game advances five seconds and then pauses to give different models time to interpret the new game state and line up their next set of commands. Here's a replay of Claude Haiku 5.5 vs. GPT-6 Luna:

Battle Drones is a particularly good example of Opus 5.5's ability to create 3D models. This page lets you browse all of the models in the game.

I released Battle Drones under the Apache 2.0 License last Tuesday. On Wednesday Gabriel Turpin released Panache (screenshots here), a fork of Battle Drones that reimagined the game for steampunk 1900s Belle Époque France, with new models and music and an animated intro sequence. Open source at work!

Pumpkin Farmer, aka Quarter Sun Cove

I live in Half Moon Bay, California, home of the annual Half Moon Bay Art and Pumpkin Festival, which includes a giant pumpkin weigh-off competition.

I decided to try building a game that wasn't just a cheap imitation of something that already existed, so I set out to create a game about farming pumpkins, growing giant pumpkins, and handling the rush of the October pumpkin season.

I called it "Quarter Sun Cove".

I'm still iterating on this project, but it's shaping up quite nicely. It's a cosy farming simulator where you spend the year tending to your giant pumpkin and planting out regular-sized pumpkins for sale in October, then sell pumpkins during pumpkin season and enter your giant pumpkin in the weigh-off.

Every character in it is a (vegetarian) animal. The mayor of the town is a pelican. You can be a pelican, skunk, raccoon, possum, beaver, coyote, fox, owl, sea otter, or harbor seal. Those species all later show up (accompanied by their children) to buy pumpkins from you.

It's absurdly cute.

You can play the latest version here. I'm not convinced by the game mechanics yet - it's actually quite complicated: you have to decide when to plant pumpkins such that they will become ripe at the weekends in October with the most visitors.

Here's the initial brainstorming session, which resulted in this spec file. Then I had Opus 5.5 Ultracode burn millions of tokens and nearly two days building it.

I told Claude to "surprise and delight the user frequently" and the result is so many little details and easter eggs. There are mischievous raccoons, an elephant seal that runs the weigh-off, harbor seals that roll their pumpkins back into the ocean, a wandering goat, and superstitions about growing giant pumpkins that sometimes come true.

This isn't my best game yet - it's not as fun to play as Battle Drones - but it represents the kind of game I want more of: weird, fun, uniquely personal - something that wouldn't have been built in the before-times.

Four times as insulting

If you are offended by AI-generated art, AI-generated music, AI-generated writing, and AI-generated code, I have bad news for you: vibe coded games combine all of those at once.

I respect those opinions, even though I don’t strongly hold them myself.

The wider games community already has an aversion to AI-generated assets in games. This has been a growing issue over the past few years as tools like Midjourney have enabled developers to generate assets for their projects. This IGN story covering complaints about slop in Valve's Steam Next Fest is a good recent example.

We now have games where everything - code, assets, dialog, and even the game design itself - can be outsourced to the models. And the results don't suck!

Building a computer game used to be one of the most challenging projects in all of software development, combining a diverse range of skills and requiring intense focus and effort over many months or even years. And now here I am spitting out a playable multiplayer RTS by prompting on my phone!

I expect that, as we've already seen with programming, this will result in a split. Some players will refuse to have anything to do with games that were built in this way. Others may embrace this as opening up game development to a much wider audience. I lean in that direction!

I certainly won't be entering any of my vibe coded games in traditional game jams or competitions - I don't feel like I've earned that right. We'll likely see new avenues emerge for vibe game developers to compare their projects.

What happens if someone actually puts the work in?

The thing I find both exciting and shameful about this is that I have got interesting results from so little creative input. The projects I've described here are loosely ordered by how much effort I've put into them. Not a single project represents more than four hours of my work (plus many more hours of Claude Code churning away by itself).

Now imagine what could be achieved by anyone who takes this seriously, invests significant creative time, applies better taste in game design, and then playtests and iterates on the result until it's as good as they can make it.

I want to see games that wouldn't have existed without these new tools.

You should build a game!

Building games in this way is so much fun. It's the perfect application for vibe coding because it's so low stakes: how much damage can you cause with a bug in a personal vibe coded game project?

(OK, you can do some damage... my attempt at audio-based multiplayer gave my wife Natalie a nasty headache!)

All of my games so far have been HTML and JavaScript using static hosting (generally GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages). Modern browsers - including mobile browsers - are incredibly capable. Frontier models already know libraries like three.js and Phaser. I'm finding these mobile web games to be indistinguishable from the native experience, at least for the kinds of games I'm trying to build.

I suggest starting with a prompt like this:

Build a mobile-friendly three.js game where...

This works on both chatgpt.com and claude.ai - you don't even need to fire up a full coding agent. As one last example, here's "Build a mobile-friendly three.js game where a mouse has to hide from a cat" by Claude Opus 5.5 Extra and by GPT-6 Extra High.

Switch to Codex or Claude Code once your project passes the proof-of-concept phase.

And if the game isn't fun enough, add this:

Make it a LOT more fun

You are only seeing the long-form articles from my blog. Subscribe to /atom/everything/ to get all of my posts, or take a look at my other subscription options.

items.content:
Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) has recently removed the word “crypto” from its flagship fund branding, instead now referring to it as the “frontier.”
The firm has claimed that it “will continue to invest in crypto” but considers this move an expansion of its focus.
To celebrate this expansion, Protos decided to go back in time and review some of the high-flying predictions and claims about crypto that a16z and its partners used to make.
a16z not chasing ‘the next hot thing’
Ali Yahya, then an a16z general partner, told CoinDesk in 2023 that a16z was “100% committed on crypto as a space” in a conversation where he pointed out that many “fair weather” venture capitalists were moving their focus away from crypto to focus on “chasing the next hot thing, which is AI at the moment.”
More recently, Yahya announced that he was exiting a16z and also noted that he cares “most about building infrastructure that enables open software ecosystems.”
He also observed that that “most uses of AI will soon be many-to-many: many humans and many agents working together.”
Daily crypto users still a billion short
Chris Dixon, an a16z general partner, while on a podcast discussing its newest crypto fund, emphasized how valuable it will be to get a billion users to be daily users of crypto.
A16z’s 2025 State of Crypto report estimates that there were somewhere between 40 and 70 million monthly active users.
AI might destroy us
Ben Horowitz, one of the founding partners, warned that the United States needs to get to “world-class” in crypto, or artificial intelligence might destroy us.
Bitcoin is the new internet
In 2014 the other founding partner, Marc Andreessen, predicted that “in 20 years, we’ll be talking about Bitcoin the way we talk about the internet today.”
Billions of crypto users to come from gaming
Arianna Simpson, then an a16z partner, predicted the next hundreds of millions or billions of crypto users would come from gaming, specifically games like Axie Infinity.
Axie Infinity would subsequently collapse.
Read more: What it was like to have Quontic Bank’s metaverse pool party all to myself
Behold, the ‘golden era of web3’
Dixon, when Crypto Fund 4 was launching in 2022, proclaimed that web3 would power the next computing cycle, and claimed that “we think we are now entering the golden era of web3.”
A quaint prediction about DAOs
Yahya, in 2021, noted that “in the same way that the internet unlocked all sorts of new fundamental value by improving messaging, DAOs have the potential to do the same by improving our social mechanisms of coordinating humans and capital on the internet.”
This prediction now feels quaint, given how frequently DAOs are ignored, exploited, or bypassed.
Read more: Black Thursday revisited: MakerDAO keeper exploited for $500K
Is TikTok ‘NFT-ised’ yet?
Sriram Krishnan, an a16z general partner and former senior White House policy advisor on artificial intelligence under Donald Trump, predicted in 2021, “I suspect we will see all forms of online content traditionally in social networks NFT-ised. Imagine, for example, every TikTok video having an ‘owner.'”
Read more: An actual NFT success story? Tascha Labs’ shattered diamond
Horowitz loses a bet
In 2014, Horowitz challenged Felix Salmon to a bet, with Horowitz staking that 10% of Americans would use BTC monthly by 2019.
Trump is like an internet comments section
Andreessen, on Joe Rogan’s show, predicted that every politician will cryptographically sign every statement they make so that there’s an immutable record.
He’s also deleted a bunch of his old tweets, including one where he relays something he overheard, namely: “Trump is like an internet comments section decided to run for president.”
Only time will tell if crypto stays at the frontier for a16z.

加拿大央行三年多来首次加息，未来可能再次加息

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 28 日，加拿大央行周三将基准利率上调 25 个基点至 2.50%。央行预计，通胀率将持续显著高于 2% 的目标水平，直至 2028 年。加拿大央行行长麦克勒姆表示，为遏制通胀，「未来可能有必要进一步上调政策利率」，不过央行官员承诺将谨慎推进政策调整。

在发言稿中，麦克勒姆表示：「上调政策利率是必要的，以降低能源价格高企所带来的影响进一步蔓延、最终演变为普遍性通胀的风险。」他还指出，由于美加贸易争端以及中东冲突，「当前的不确定性仍然处于较高水平」，央行对此保持警惕。

此外，加拿大央行上调了经济增长预期，主要得益于消费者支出和出口表现强劲，以及企业投资有望回升。随着企业越来越多地采用人工智能，并利用总理卡尼推出的新税收抵扣政策，预计企业投资将进一步增加。

Google Cloud outlines MPC service for institutional Bitcoin custody
Google Cloud has detailed its preview MPC service for institutional Bitcoin custody as it holds a New York symposium focused on digital asset security.
Google’s cloud computing division is progressing with a service that lets financial institutions jointly authorize and sign cryptocurrency transactions without giving any single party control over the full private key.
Google Cloud detailed its Multi-party Compute (MPC) service in documentation updated Monday, positioning the preview product for institutional Bitcoin custody. The service remains in preview, meaning Google provides it as is, with potentially limited support.
The documentation update preceded Google Cloud’s MPC Symposium, taking place Wednesday in New York. The event promises an “exclusive revealing of Google’s frontier MPC product and research projects,” according to its description, and features speakers from financial institutions including Morgan Stanley, OKX, Citi and Wells Fargo.
Google Cloud’s release notes for the service date back to August 2026. On Oct. 1, Google expanded its Bitcoin security rules to evaluate transaction amounts, identify destination address types and detect change outputs.
The Alphabet subsidiary has previously explored related technology through Confidential Space, a cloud environment designed to support secure multi-party computation and data sharing, as described in a June blog post.
Cointelegraph contacted Google Cloud and Rich Widmann, Google’s director of digital assets strategy, for clarification on the service’s availability and launch timeline.
Related: Tech giants rush to block 8 eMudhra certs that could enable fake sites

items.content:
In brief
- House Oversight Committee Chairman James Comer (R-KY) has opened an investigation into Delaware's proposal for companies run day-to-day by AI agents.
- Comer warned the plan could protect AI firms and investors from liability, and asked Gov. Matt Meyer for documents and communications by November 9.
- Delaware officials say the AIC would make AI agents accountable inside a supervised sandbox, with draft legislation expected next year.
House Oversight Committee Chairman James Comer (R-KY) is investigating Delaware's effort to create a new kind of corporate entity run by an artificial intelligence agent, the committee said on Monday.
In a letter to Delaware Gov. Matt Meyer, Comer raised concerns about the proposed Artificial Intelligence Company, or AIC, which would give the person or entity behind it protection from liability for harms caused by the AI agent running it.
🚨 Delaware wants to let AI agents run companies while shielding their owners from liability when the AI causes harm.
Chairman @RepJamesComer is seeking documents, including internal AI chat logs, from Gov. Meyer to find out who’s behind the plan. https://t.co/tPzK0qFC4C
— Oversight Committee (@GOPoversight) October 26, 2026
"We are concerned that Delaware's AIC proposal could be used to protect powerful AI companies and their investors from responsibility for reckless harmful actions, while also protecting non-transparent forces seeking anticompetitive regulatory capture behind state AI initiatives," Comer wrote.
The letter questions the role of private-sector contributors to the proposal. It notes that a December 2025 report by Delaware's AI Commission made no mention of efforts to assess safety risks or consult independent experts, and that the Secretary of State's office declined to tell reporters about its working relationship with an AI company involved in the project.
Comer asked Meyer to hand over all documents and communications about the AIC's development since January 2025, including "internal AI chat logs," along with agreements with outside contributors, records on safety concerns and all drafts of the proposal, by November 9. The committee said the information could inform federal legislation, including proposals to limit state AI regulatory initiatives.
Delaware's AI company plan
Delaware Secretary of State Charuni Patibanda-Sanchez and John Nay, CEO of legal AI firm Norm Ai, unveiled the proposal in a Fortune op-ed in July, describing a public-private partnership led by Norm Ai.
An AIC would be able to sue and be sued, hold property and take on obligations at its AI agent's direction. It would have a single member responsible for keeping it adequately capitalized, and that member would be shielded from its debts unless it failed to capitalize the company or used it to commit fraud or a willful violation of law. AICs would operate only within a 30-month regulatory sandbox overseen by a committee of state officials and outside experts, would have to disclose their status to counterparties, and would be barred from banking.
The proposal aims to "wrap AI in legal form," the authors wrote, arguing that a recognizable legal identity would make an autonomous system's conduct "visible, traceable, and accountable."
Some legal scholars have questioned that reasoning. "There's really no overarching regulatory plan here for dealing with the fallout that AI-governed companies could bring," Christopher Bruner, a business law professor at the University of Georgia, told WHYY in September.
Patibanda-Sanchez has rejected the idea that the plan is a liability shield. "We're not trying to shield liability. We're trying to define where exactly liability lands when there's some type of malfeasance or psychopathic behavior," she told Bloomberg Law in July.
Meyer has also defended the effort. "It is coming, and the solution is not ignoring it," he said on a WHYY call-in show in September. State lawmakers are expected to consider draft legislation when they return in January.

items.content:
Cybersecurity’s Black October: How to protect yourself
Each day brings news of another AI-powered attack, or a newly discovered vulnerability. Here’s what’s happening and how ordinary people can protect themselves online.
Cybersecurity professionals are having a brutal month.
What’s being dubbed Black October isn’t even over, and it’s already brought about several dozen major cyberattacks and AI-identified vulnerabilities across the internet.
When critical vulnerabilities in PHP, the programming language used by around 70% of websites, were uncovered with the help of AI tools and disclosed by the PHP Foundation on Oct. 21, the race to patch servers around the world began.
Cloud services provider Cloudflare reported millions of attempts to exploit the vulnerability after its disclosure, following thousands of attempts in the preceding hours.
Some countries, including France and Finland, temporarily pulled access to certain websites while the US National Security Agency (NSA) warned organizations to patch the flaws immediately or take affected systems offline.
“We are at Security Armageddon now,” said NEAR founder Illia Polosukhin. Anthropic’s chief security adviser Jason Clinton warned that, “as bad as things have gotten in the past 4 days, they are going to get a lot worse before they get better.”
Citizens of the United Kingdom are even being urged to “be ready” for an emergency, such as severe weather or cyberattacks, that could cut off access to critical infrastructure such as water, electricity or the internet. US military installation have been told to prep for 90 days of independent operation under the FORTRESS initiative.
Houston, do we have a problem?
Beyond rushing out to stockpile canned food and walkie-talkies, is there anything else ordinary people can do to mitigate their exposure?
So how bad is Black October, really?
“It’s really bad. It looks like the rest of the internet is waking up to the reality we had three months ago,” Rob Hamilton, a Bitcoin security researcher involved in the Bitcoin Red Team, tells Magazine.
UK government is urging citizens to be ready for an emergency. Source: gov.uk
In the past week or so, cloud platform Railway disclosed that an attacker has accessed and decrypted customer credentials and API keys, apparently targeting AI providers.
Related: France is world’s most dangerous place for Bitcoiners: 90 attacks in 7 months
Medical testing giant Quest Diagnostics confirmed a breach of private patient health data, while Indian security firm eMudhra was found to have eight digital certificate authorities with weak keys that could potentially have let attackers impersonate trusted websites. And code hosting platform GitHub experienced a major service disruption that highlighted how heavily the software world relies on shared infrastructure.
GitHub’s senior director of security, Austin Devers, says incidents like this are a “clear reminder that reliability requires constant work,” because modern development is “so connected.”
Railway security incident. Source: Railway
Jonathan Riss, an OSINT and blockchain intelligence analyst at blockchain security firm CertiK, tells Magazine:
“What concerns us most is how a single weakness in shared infrastructure can expose many organizations simultaneously.”
Unfortunately, he adds that AI’s ability to find vulnerabilities is not matched by its ability to fix them:
“Finding vulnerabilities faster does not automatically give us the capacity to resolve them faster.”
Why things are likely to get worse
One reason the problem is getting worse is because AI has changed the economics of cybersecurity.
What once required nation-state resources and sophisticated hackers to pull off can now be achieved by a teenager in a basement somewhere.
AI entrepreneur and investor Matt Shumer said that AI enables non technical users to find weak spots and exploit them, leaving defenders are “racing to keep up.”
“Every weak spot still has to be fixed, tested and installed on millions of systems run by people who are already stretched thin.”
Devers says AI-assisted security tools are “dramatically” lowering the barrier to “uncovering complex, deep-seated flaws in widely used codebases.”
Related: Keystone says website breach exposed hardware wallet buyers’ addresses
What can ordinary people actually do?
There are some practical steps ordinary folk can use to stay safer online during this volatile period.
The internet is under attack. Source: Matt Shumer
Shumer recommends staying off sites you don’t know, and definitely don’t enter passwords or card numbers into unfamiliar sites “until this blows over” since smaller sites are the “least likely to have patched.”
Delete any apps you don’t use and unplug smart gadgets you don’t need. Keep some cash at home and enough groceries for a few days, “if you want to be extra careful.”
Devers says the best defense is “locking down personal access points and keeping overall footprints small.” Turn on Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) across all accounts, ideally using an authenticator app or hardware security key rather than text messages.
“This acts as a circuit breaker and stops hackers from logging into your account even if the underlying software is compromised.”
Never reuse passwords either, he says. “Create strong, unique passwords for every site, and periodically disconnect old app permissions or third-party connections you no longer use.” Keep your devices and web browsers updated automatically:
“While platform teams work to fix cloud-level security issues on the backend, keeping your devices secure ensures hackers can’t use your personal hardware as a back door into your accounts.”
To self-custody or not self-custody, that is the question
While the alarming rise in security incidents has caused some crypto holders to consider alternatives and some experts to advise against self-custody, others, such as Bitcoin advocate and Casa chief security officer Jameson Lopp, remind users that defeats the whole purpose.
“You can only benefit from Bitcoin’s unique properties when you hold your own keys. [...] Giving up your keys doesn’t make the risk go away, he says. It moves the risk somewhere you can’t see or control.”
Riss recommends separating small amounts you intend to use into a hot wallet, from longer-term holdings in a hardware wallet, and to “actually read what you’re signing rather than approving blind.”
While these precautions can reduce your vulnerability to attack, everyday users can only lock down local issues, and have little ability to affect wider problems.
You can “reduce blast radius,” he says, “not prevent infrastructure compromise.”
So while users can improve their cyber hygiene, ultimately, “the structural burden sits with platforms and providers.”
Magazine: Scammer loses $4.8M stored on tampered Ledgers: Asia Express
items.title: Cybersecurity’s Black October: How to protect yourself

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
DTCC unit launches tokenization services
The post-trade market infrastructure provider said the tokenization services will create a “practical path” for tokenized securities adoption.
The Depository Trust Company (DTC), a subsidiary of The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC), has launched tokenization services enabling eligible users to mint tokenized representations of securities held at DTC.
DTCC clients are eligible to use the DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS). DTS will convert between traditional and tokenized forms of securities that are transferable to digital wallets and retain the same ownership rights and investor protections as their traditional counterparts, the company announced on Wednesday.
The post-trade market infrastructure provider said that 20 of its clients have signed agreements to access the services, including Alpaca, Citadel Securities, Citi, Clear Street, DriveWealth, Fidelity Investments, Interchange Clearing and JPMorgan.
DTC has more than $114 trillion in assets under custody, including stocks and exchange-traded funds. The company said its service will create a “practical path” for tokenized securities adoption.
In December 2025, the US Securities and Exchange Commission issued a “no action” letter stating that it would not recommend enforcement action against DTCC’s subsidiary in relation to its proposed tokenization program.
In May, DTCC said it planned a full service launch of trading of tokenized securities in October 2026, following a July 2026 pilot.
The tokenization service is currently integrated with Canton Network and DTCC’s Besu private network, with plans to add additional blockchain networks in 2027.
Related: US financial markets ‘poised to move on-chain’ amid DTCC tokenization greenlight

items.content:
In brief
- Birch Hill raised a $4 million seed round led by Multicoin Capital, with ParaFi, Castle Island Ventures and Nascent participating, bringing its total funding to $6.5 million.
- The firm curates vaults on Morpho and has applied to FINRA for broker-dealer status to sell private credit to accredited investors.
- It plans to eventually securitize multifamily, agriculture and energy loans onchain, and has hired three people from Yearn and one from Gauntlet.
A New York startup founded by Wall Street alumni wants to put American apartment, farm, and energy loans on public blockchains, and it just raised the money to start.
Birch Hill said Wednesday it closed a $4 million seed round led by Multicoin Capital, with participation from ParaFi Capital, Castle Island Ventures, and Nascent. The round brings its total funding to $6.5 million.
The firm is led by CEO Bhavin Vaid, a former Goldman Sachs investment banking analyst who later worked in private equity at Cerberus Capital Management and co-founded crypto investment firm Halo Capital. Co-founder and COO Connor Flanagan spent more than four years at BlackRock, including on its Aladdin risk platform, before roles at Digital Currency Group and analytics firm Flipside.
Birch Hill operates in three divisions. Its Vaults arm is an official curator on Morpho, an onchain lending protocol, where it assesses credit and sets risk parameters for vaults and markets. Its Strategies unit builds onchain credit products, including a strategy called Birch Hill Absolute Value. Its Enterprise division has applied to FINRA for broker-dealer membership, which would let it place private credit offerings with verified accredited investors.
“Loan originators need new sources of capital, and onchain lenders need credit they can trust,” Vaid said in a statement.
Longer term, the firm plans to securitize pools of U.S. multifamily, agriculture, and energy loans designed to be held onchain within the U.S. regulatory framework. Birch Hill said it met with the SEC’s Crypto Task Force in August as part of that effort. It argues that banks, insurers, and other fiduciaries will only allocate to credit packaged in structures they recognize.
The round funds an eight-person team that includes three hires from vault platform Yearn: Brad Schlagel, who led development of Yearn v3, Ian Plosker, and Alex Cornwell. Traver Normandi joins from risk management firm Gauntlet to lead business development.
“Private credit is a fragmented, relationship-driven market, which makes it one of the clearest opportunities to build new financial infrastructure onchain,” said Shayon Sengupta, general partner and co-head of venture at Multicoin.
The raise comes as Washington warms to onchain finance. The SEC proposed Regulation Crypto Assets in August, which would let projects raise money through token sales without full registration. Morpho has also gained traction with traditional players, powering Coinbase’s fixed-rate USDC loans against Bitcoin.

DTCC代币化服务正式上线，Ondo Finance成为生态协作方

⚡️泰国最高法院正式将比特币裁定为法律意义上的「财产」

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 28 日，泰国最高法院近期在一宗刑事案件中认定，比特币具有可持有、可交易和可兑换现金的经济价值，可被视为法律意义上的「财产」。

近期的一起案件中，受害人将 5 万美元兑换为比特币后，转给了犯罪团伙。争议焦点是：以电子方式存在的比特币，能否成为刑事犯罪中「财产被侵害」的对象。泰国最高法院全体法官审理的第 4929/2569 号判决认为比特币具有市场价值；可以买卖，也可在有买方的情况下兑换为现金；公众能够持有和控制它；因而，受害人转出的比特币并非「无形且无价值的数据」，而是可构成财产犯罪对象的财产。

需要指出的是，泰国法院在该刑事案件中确认，比特币可作为受法律保护、也可能被犯罪侵害的财产，而非确认它具有泰铢那样的法定支付地位。

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Moody's has assigned A2 long-term and P-1 short-term deposit ratings to Ripple USD, the stablecoin issued by Ripple's Standard Custody & Trust Company.
- The agency pointed to reserves held mostly in short-term U.S. government assets and cash, with a target of 103% coverage of tokens in circulation.
- The rating follows final OCC approval for Ripple's national trust bank, as RLUSD gains backing from firms including Standard Chartered and Mastercard.
Moody's Ratings has assigned an A2 long-term deposit rating and a P-1 short-term deposit rating to Ripple USD (RLUSD), the dollar-backed stablecoin issued by Ripple subsidiary Standard Custody & Trust Company, the agency said on Tuesday.
A2 is the sixth-highest long-term grade on Moody's scale, and P-1 is its top short-term grade. The agency said the ratings reflect the quality of RLUSD's reserves, which are held mainly in Treasury bills, other short-term U.S. government assets and cash, most of it with custodian BNY. Eligible institutional holders can redeem RLUSD at par within two business days.
Moody's also flagged gaps in holders' protection, noting that Standard Custody is not a bankruptcy-remote entity, and RLUSD holders do not currently have a direct ownership interest in the reserves—though the agency said the GENIUS Act, the U.S. stablecoin law due to take effect in 2027, will exclude required reserves from an issuer's bankruptcy estate. The ratings were requested by the issuer, Moody's said.
The rating came a day after Ripple won final approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency for Ripple National Trust Bank, which will manage RLUSD's reserves and act as their collateral trustee. RLUSD will continue to be issued by Standard Custody under New York Department of Financial Services oversight, putting the stablecoin under both state and federal supervision.
RLUSD's institutional push
Launched in December 2024 on Ethereum and the XRP Ledger, RLUSD has a market capitalization of about $2.6 billion, according to CoinGecko, still a small share of a stablecoin market worth some $300 billion.
Ripple has pitched the token at institutions rather than retail traders. Earlier this month, Standard Chartered began offering institutional custody of RLUSD through its Dubai branch, and said it was working with Ripple and LMAX Group on a "collateral mirroring" setup that would let clients use the stablecoin as trading collateral without moving it off the bank's books.
In November 2025, Ripple teamed up with Mastercard, WebBank and Gemini to explore using RLUSD on the XRP Ledger to settle fiat transactions on the Gemini Credit Card, pending regulatory approvals. RLUSD had just passed a $1 billion market cap at the time, making it the 11th-largest stablecoin, according to DefiLlama.

items.content:
Morning Minute is a daily newsletter written by Tyler Warner. The analysis and opinions expressed are his own and do not necessarily reflect those of Decrypt. And check out our daily news show 'FOMO HOUR' covering all of the top stories and market action.
GM!
Today’s top news:
- Crypto majors rebound 2-4% ahead of FOMC; BTC at $81.3k
- BTC ETFs see another $176M in net inflows; STRC at $99.53
- Google previews crypto custody service for banks
- Ripple wins final approval from OCC for National Trust Bank
- Robinhood misses earnings but crypto beats; RH Chain leaders surge
Robinhood Misses, But Crypto Beats and the Chain Surprises
Robinhood missed on both revenue and EPS on Tuesday, despite crypto beating expectations. But the more interesting things happened on the call.
Revenue came in at a record $1.42 billion, a hair under the $1.43 billion expected. EPS was $0.51 against $0.55 forecast. Crypto revenue rose to $120 million from $100 million in Q2, up 20% sequentially, though still 55% below last year’s $268 million. Trading volume was $50 billion, with $29 billion of that through Bitstamp.
Event contracts are now the bigger business: $173 million, up from $156 million, on a record 16.4 billion contracts traded, more than seven times a year ago. Between prediction markets and crypto, more than a fifth of Robinhood’s revenue now comes from products that barely existed two years ago.
And then came the call and Vlad’s commentary on Robinhood Chain.
“It caught us by surprise.”
Vlad admitted that Robinhood Chain has outrun their internal forecasts and expectations. The chain launched July 1. By late August it was generating more fees over a rolling 30 days than Ethereum or Base. Tenev said they’ve had to staff up a team to keep pace, and that builders have been telling them Robinhood could be doing more.
His response: “You should expect to see us really ramping the investment, because you just don’t see growth of a new ecosystem like this. It’s an uncommon thing. A lot of chains have launched over the past few months that have had an incomparably small level of traction compared to this. So we’re doubling down.”
Then he described where he thinks it goes: “Imagine if you take a stock token, make it fully programmable just like software. What can you do? Can you have tokenized options contracts?”
This was music to the Robinhood Chain bulls’ ears. And it was enough to send the Robinhood Chain leaders up 20-50% across the board, led by Pons +18%, AI (Long) +33% and Orbio +57%.
The message was clear. Robinhood isn’t treating tokenized equities as a product feature, it’s treating them as a primitive other people build on top of. That’s already happening with projects like Long.xyz pairing meme coins against tokenized NVDA and TSLA and Orbio funding AI inference credits with fees paid in tokenized Nvidia. Neither was Robinhood’s idea, and both only exist because the stock tokens do.
Now those teams can expect more support from the Robinhood team. Two tweets from Robinhood Crypto on Tuesday already evidence this leaning in, supporting both Long and Priors. So earnings may have been a miss, but the earnings call was a big win. Now let’s see just what leaning in means…

⚡️观点：比特币巨鲸群体近24小时减持明显，FOMC魔咒或再度来袭

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 28 日，据分析师 alicharts，尽管比特币今日涨超 1%，但比特币仍有很大可能受到 FOMC 魔咒影响，再度出现明显下跌。

据其提供的数据，比特币巨鲸群体最近已实现约 1.56 亿美元的利润，这增加了潜在的卖压。同时，巨鲸群体的持仓在过去 24 小时内也减少了约 8162 枚 BTC，价值约 6.64 亿美元。这一下降表明，大型持有者在 FOMC 决定之前正在减少敞口。

alicharts 认为，比特币当前关键支撑位接近 81,000 美元，根据 URPD，在那里之前几乎有 100 万枚 BTC 成交。如果跌破，接下来需要关注 77,000 美元，然后是 67,000 美元。而要转为看涨，比特币需要突破 84,500 美元，在那里大约有 62 万枚 BTC 成交。

此外，近期 FOMC 与比特币币价波动规律显示，比特币在会议后的第一个小时内的波动通常小于 1%。更清晰的方向往往在接下来的 24 小时内显现，并且通常会持续到一周后。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
Settlement concerns prompt Euronext to halt CoinShares’ Zcash ETP ahead of debut
A Euronext spokesperson told Cointelegraph the suspension was due to “operational settlement requirements” and remains in effect until settlement operations are supported by the CSD.
Stock exchange operator Euronext suspended CoinShares’ Zcash exchange-traded product (ETP) on Wednesday, when it was scheduled to debut for trading on Euronext Paris.
In a Wednesday notice, the exchange operator said the CoinShares Zcash ETP (ZCSH) was suspended from trading on Euronext Paris until further notice. The notice did not provide a reason for the decision.
CoinShares’ Zcash ETP will remain suspended until “standard settlement operations can be fully supported by the Central Securities Depository (CSD),” Euronext’s press and communications manager, Flavio Bornancin-Tomasella, told Cointelegraph, adding that the measure was strictly limited to “operational settlement requirements.”
The suspension notice delays what would have been the fourth Zcash-based ETP listed in Europe. Other companies that launched Zcash ETPs earlier this year include 21Shares, Virtune and Valor.
CoinShares announced the planned launch of its ZCASH ETP on Euronext Paris earlier on Wednesday. Cointelegraph contacted CoinShares for comment on the matter but did not receive a response by publication.
Related: Zcash co-founder calls to stop funding ‘over $125M’ grants program
items.title: Settlement concerns prompt Euronext to halt CoinShares’ Zcash ETP ahead of debut

items.author: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun
items.content:
Mirae Asset Securities issues tokenized notes on Solana
The company’s Hong Kong unit issued six-month notes under its $3 billion program, extending blockchain-based distribution to institutional investors.
The Hong Kong arm of Mirae Asset Securities, one of South Korea’s largest securities firms, has issued tokenized notes on Solana to institutional investors.
The transaction involved six-month floating-rate notes issued under the firm’s $3 billion structured note program, according to Wednesday’s announcement. Singapore-based digital market infrastructure operator Marketnode acted as an authorized distributor.
Mirae Asset Securities managed token issuance, payments and the notes’ lifecycle using its internal digital infrastructure. The company said the transaction could provide a model for distributing a wider range of structured products through blockchain-based channels.
The securities firm is part of South Korea’s Mirae Asset Financial Group, whose businesses span brokerage, investment banking, asset management and insurance.
The group has been expanding into digital assets, with affiliate Mirae Asset Consulting acquiring a controlling stake in crypto exchange Korbit in July, which has since rebranded to Digital X.
The group’s asset management arm, Mirae Asset Global Investments, operates the Global X and TIGER exchange-traded fund brands. Its website lists $275 billion in ETF assets under management as of June 2026 and describes its ETF business as the world’s 12th-largest.
Related: Hong Kong names Nasdaq-listed Solana Company a strategic enterprise

items.author: galadran
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[chrisweekly]: Right, so it's not just git, it's a bunch of system-provided utilities; macOS trusts bad certs, and these utils that trust the OS are affected. I use homebrew for my git and curl but haven't yet checked to confirm whether that matters here. 
Kind of outrageous that Apple's guidance is to edit the cert chain manually, and to expect that subsequent OS updates may revert your mitigation, reintroducing the vulnerability (as happened at least once so far).

[jrochkind1]: That MacOS hasn't removed from OS-level /etc/ssl seems like a big deal, affecting more than just OS-supplied git. Is /etc/certs not used by most graphical Mac software, I guess?  The chaotic state of OS-level cert management, on Linux as well, is pretty dismaying. If Apple is still trying to brand themselves as security-forward, you'd think removing the revoked CA certs from /etc in a system update would be a pretty easy thing to do?

[truelson]: Here's what apple (themselves) recommends to patch:  https://support.apple.com/en-us/149555  Pretty much every developer on mac should probably run their patch.

[qaz_plm]: Apple’s statement:  https://support.apple.com/en-us/149555

[faxmeyourcode]: While there is no proof that anyone knew about these weak keys for the year and a half that they were trusted by virtually everybody, and there's no evidence of MITM attacks happening in the wild because of it, you can imagine the payoff that a three letter agency would have if, for even 10 days, there was an opportunity to harvest credentials from important people in high places. I have no evidence or proof, but I am convinced this wrap/unwrap key generation debacle was intentional...

Brazil’s Largest Private Bank Itaú Unibanco Becomes Country’s First to Notify Regulator of Crypto Brokerage Operations Under New Rules

Brazil’s largest private bank, Itaú Unibanco, notified the central bank of its cryptocurrency trading and custody operations on October 27, becoming the country’s first bank to do so under the new digital-asset rules. The framework allows banks already authorized by the central bank to offer crypto services through a notification process, while dedicated virtual-asset service providers must apply for operating authorization. The deadline for existing operators to submit notifications or applications is October 30. Itaú has offered crypto services since December 2023 and currently supports 15 cryptoassets. — link

Foresight News 消息，Bitget 联合 Reality、Keyring 发布研究报告，探讨代币化股票、永续合约与去中心化借贷的协同机制，并通过模拟测算评估相关策略的潜在收益及风险。报告指出，代币化股票的应用正从传统股票交易延伸至抵押借贷、资产管理及系统化投资策略等更多场景。研究以 Reality 的 rToken 为基础，结合股票永续合约对冲及链上借贷机制，探索股票基差收益策略。历史模拟数据显示，2025 年 12 月 15 日至 2026 年 10 月 19 日期间，该策略指数在样本内及样本外的年化净收益率分别约为 7% 和 4%，毛资金费率溢价约为 11%–14%。报告同时指出，融资成本、交易执行费用、市场流动性及风险管理是影响策略实际收益的关键因素。Bitget 与 Keyring 计划共同开发股票基差指数，并依托 Reality 的 rToken 构建链上借贷市场。其中 Reality 提供代币化股票资产敞口，Keyring 负责开发指数方法论并构建相关借贷市场。该指数旨在通过组合 rToken 持仓与对应股票永续合约的对冲仓位，捕捉资金费率及基差收益机会，为代币化股票在链上金融场景中的应用提供新的策略路径。

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- South Korean crypto exchange Bithumb said an outside party accessed its internal mobile groupware system and leaked personal information.
- The exchange is investigating whether customer data was among the information exposed, though an industry source told Yonhap some had leaked.
- Brokerage Daishin Securities and asset manager Mirae Asset Global Investments also reported breaches, as authorities inspect the incidents.
Bithumb, South Korea's second-largest crypto exchange, said an unauthorized outside party had accessed its internal mobile groupware system, resulting in a leak of personal information, according to Yonhap News Agency.
The exchange is investigating whether customer data was compromised, Reuters reported, citing Yonhap. An industry source told Yonhap that some personal information belonging to Bithumb customers had been leaked.
Bithumb was one of three South Korean financial firms to report data breaches on Wednesday, local time. Brokerage Daishin Securities said the personal information of 38,490 customers, including names, email addresses and mobile phone numbers, was leaked after it detected signs of unauthorized access last week. It said it would compensate customers for any resulting damage in accordance with the law.
Asset manager Mirae Asset Global Investments also confirmed a hacking incident, and financial authorities have begun an inspection.
Spokespeople for the three firms could not be immediately reached for comment by Reuters. The breaches follow a wave of hacking attacks on 16 South Korean financial firms, including banks, that had caused around 100,000 data leaks, the Financial Services Commission said earlier this month, according to Reuters.
The Korean breaches were reported the same day Coinbase said a security incident at analytics vendor Amplitude had exposed some of its customers' contact data. Binance founder Changpeng "CZ" Zhao listed all four incidents in a tweet on Wednesday, warning that leaked exchange data "is mostly used for phishing, SIM swapping, and social engineering."
4 data leaks reported today:
1. Coinbase's vendor Amplitude exposed some users’ contact data (funds unaffected).
2. Bithumb (Korea) had user data leaks.In TradFi, two securities firms in Korea leaked data:
3. Mirae Asset
4. Daishin SecuritiesYou can't prevent a leak, but…
— CZ 🔶 BNB (@cz_binance) October 28, 2026
"You can't prevent a leak, but you can protect yourself," Zhao wrote, urging users to sign up to each exchange with a unique email alias, avoid text message-based two-factor authentication and ask their phone carrier for a number lock. Leaked addresses and holdings data "have led to real-world extortion and robberies," he added.
Separately, South Korea's Science Ministry and the Korea Internet & Security Agency have urged website operators to check for recently disclosed flaws in PHP, the programming language behind much of the web, which let attackers run commands on a server without logging in. Bithumb has not said how its system was accessed.
Bithumb's turbulent year
The breach is the latest setback for Bithumb in 2026. In February, the exchange mistakenly credited 695 users with a total of 620,000 BTC, worth about $43 billion at the time, during a promotion meant to hand out small cash rewards. The deposits existed only on Bithumb's internal ledger, and the exchange said it recovered 99.7% of the Bitcoin.
In March, South Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit fined Bithumb 36.8 billion won ($24.6 million) and ordered a six-month partial suspension over anti-money laundering failures, but a Seoul court blocked the suspension in April.
Bithumb has since set out a three-stage plan to list on the stock market in 2028, while its CEO, Lee Jae-won, was booked as a bribery suspect in June over the alleged hiring of a National Assembly member's son.

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
AI开始挑战真实工程设计：GPT-6 Astra通过率37%，5款模型挂零

动察 Beating AI 快讯，AI 初创公司 Xplore 发布 RWE-Bench，测试大模型解决真实工程问题的能力。

11 款模型挑战 20 项机械、电气和航空航天任务，GPT-6 Astra 以 37% 的单次平均通过率排名第一，Claude Opus 5.5 为 29%，GPT-6.1 Sol 为 25%。另有 5 款模型全部失败，包括 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、GLM-5.3 和 Grok 4.7。

任务涵盖发动机曲轴设计、电路板布线和涡轮叶片散热仿真。设计曲轴要兼顾尺寸、重量、强度和疲劳寿命；给一块已经安装近 300 个元件的八层电路板布线，需要连接 71 条信号线，同时控制时序误差和阻抗；模拟涡轮叶片散热，还得正确计算高温气流与叶片之间的热量传递。

每款模型使用各自配套的 Agent 工具链，直接操作专业工程软件。每道题最多运行 24 小时，独立尝试 5 次。提交的设计由工程软件和物理求解器自动验证，任何一项硬性要求不达标都算失败。全部 1100 次测试中，有 4 道题始终无人攻克。不过，允许每题尝试 5 次后，Claude Opus 5.5 的任务通过率升至 70%，反超 Astra 的 60%。

Xplore 希望把这类工程任务进一步变成强化学习训练环境，让 AI 通过反复设计、仿真和纠错提高工程能力。

items.content:
Liquid AI发布LFM3，1.7B小模型跑网页Agent胜过9B

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Liquid AI 发布第三代基础模型 LFM3，一次推出六款约 20 亿参数的小模型，覆盖文本、视觉、语音和决策任务。其中，1.7B 文本模型支持 256K 上下文，4-bit 量化后的权重仅约 1GB。六款模型均支持单张 GPU 微调，可以利用企业自己的数据进行专门训练，再部署到手机、电脑或私有服务器。

Liquid AI 重新设计了模型架构，将短卷积、局部注意力和全局注意力结合，并针对工具调用、网页操作等 Agent 任务进行专门训练。相比上一代 LFM2.5-2.6B，新模型参数减少约 35%，部分任务的成绩却大幅提高。

官方测试中，LFM3-1.7B 在 WebArena-Verified 浏览器操作任务上得分 38.42，上一代只有 3.02，还超过了参数量约为其 5 倍的 Qwen3.5-9B（28.94）。在 AutomationBench 企业工作流测试中，其任务成功率达到 41.29%，Qwen3.5-9B 则为 15.10%。

但换到复杂编程和长文本任务，情况发生了逆转。SWE-bench Verified 编程测试中，LFM3-1.7B 得分 43.4，低于 Qwen3.5-9B 的 51.2。128K 长文本测试中，两者分别得分 65.6 和 87.1。Liquid AI 也在模型卡中明确表示，不建议用这款小模型执行复杂的 Agent 编程任务。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374160

items.content:
首支PEPE现货ETF即将成型？Canary本月曾推进上市申请

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 28 日，美国资产管理机构 Canary Capital 于 2026 年 4 月 8 日向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交了 Canary PEPE ETF 的 S-1 注册声明，并于 10 月 2 日提交了修订版文件（S-1/A）。该基金拟直接持有 PEPE 代币，计划在 Cboe BZX 交易平台上市，托管方包括 BitGo 等。

这一申请是继比特币、以太坊现货 ETF 获批后，发行商尝试将 Meme 币纳入受监管产品的举措之一。修订文件明确了信托结构、投资目标（提供扣除运营费用后的 PEPE 价格敞口）以及发行篮子规模等细节，但 SEC 尚未宣布注册声明生效，也无批准决定。目前无固定审批截止日期，市场预期可能将会进一步进展，但审批结果仍存在不确定性。

虽然 ETF 申请消息曾多次引发市场关注，并在部分时段推动 PEPE 价格波动，但截至目前，该产品仍处于监管审查阶段，投资者尚无法通过传统证券账户获得 PEPE 现货敞口，仍需继续关注 SEC 后续文件更新与最终决定。

此前报道，Justin Sun 时隔两年再次交易 PEPE，关联地址目前总计持有 11.8 万亿枚 PEPE，提出均价 0.000004114 美元。

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Coinbase said a security incident at analytics vendor Amplitude affected contact data belonging to a "small subset" of its customers.
- The exchange said it had found no evidence of unauthorized access to its own systems, and that customer funds were not affected.
- The incident comes 17 months after Coinbase disclosed a breach involving bribed overseas support agents.
Coinbase has said a security incident at Amplitude, a third-party analytics provider, affected contact data belonging to a "small subset" of its customers, while stressing that the exchange itself had not been breached.
"Coinbase has not had a data breach," the company's support account said in a tweet on Tuesday night. "Amplitude, an analytics vendor, experienced a security incident which impacted a small subset of Coinbase customer contact data, among other Amplitude customers."
Coinbase has not had a data breach.
Amplitude, an analytics vendor, experienced a security incident which impacted a small subset of Coinbase customer contact data, among other Amplitude customers.
We’ve found no evidence of unauthorized access to Coinbase systems, and…
— Coinbase Support (@CoinbaseSupport) October 28, 2026
Coinbase said it had found no evidence of unauthorized access to its systems and that customer funds were “not impacted.” It is notifying affected customers and regulators in line with its legal obligations.
The company did not say how many customers were affected, what kinds of contact data were exposed, or when the incident took place. Nor did it name the other Amplitude customers affected.
Coinbase's 2025 breach
Coinbase disclosed a far more serious incident in May 2025, when it said cybercriminals had bribed overseas customer support agents to steal personal data belonging to less than 1% of its monthly transacting users. The exchange refused a $20 million ransom demand and instead offered a $20 million bounty for information leading to the attackers' arrest.
A later filing with the Maine attorney general put the number of affected customers at 69,461, with data including names, addresses, masked Social Security numbers and government ID images exposed.
Crypto firms have repeatedly seen customer data exposed through partners. In September, hardware wallet maker Trezor said a breach at shipping provider ShipMonk had exposed the names, phone numbers and home addresses of 67,000 U.S. customers, on top of nearly 14,000 it had disclosed in August. Some of the records dated back to 2019, years after ShipMonk had told Trezor they were deleted. Trezor warned affected customers to watch for fake emails, calls and letters, and about risks to their physical security.
At the time, cybercrime consultant David Sehyeon Baek told Decrypt that a letter carrying a name and home address signals "we can locate you," and that stolen data stays useful for years because people rarely move or change their numbers.

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
DiffuSpace把Qwen3.6改成扩散模型，GB300单卡跑出680 Token/s

动察 Beating AI 快讯，香港大学教授孔令鹏创办的扩散智能（DiffuSpace）发布并开源 Clover-35B-A3B-Preview。

模型基于阿里 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 改造，总参数 350 亿，每次推理激活约 30 亿参数。

传统大模型通常从左到右逐个生成 Token，Clover 则采用块扩散，一次生成一小段文本，再通过并行预测和反复修正完成输出。团队还改造了 Gated DeltaNet，将历史信息压缩保存，同时让当前文本块内的 Token 双向交互，以兼顾生成速度和上下文理解。

官方公布的六项 Agent 评测中，Clover 均取得所列模型的最高分。SWE-bench Verified 达到 73.6%，Terminal-Bench 2.1 达到 51.7%，超过原版 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，以及 LLaDA2.2 Flash、Mercury 2.5 等扩散模型。不过，对比名单没有纳入 10 月 19 日发布的 Mercury 3。

速度方面，Clover 在单张 NVIDIA GB300 上，以 BF16 精度、单并发运行内部 Agent 任务，生成速度达到 680 Token/s。在 H200 上达到 515 Token/s，超过使用 DFlash2 加速的同规模 Qwen 模型（365 Token/s）。团队还将 INT4 量化版本部署到仅有 16GB 显存的 RTX 5070 Ti 上，MATH-500 测试速度达到 101.8 Token/s。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374154

items.author: Cointelegraph by William Suberg
items.content:
Bitcoin price eyes $82K as Morgan Stanley strategist says most of correction is over
Bitcoin sought to rebuild support at $80,000 while Asian and US tech stocks extended a rebound into key corporate earnings releases.
Bitcoin (BTC) approached $82,000 on Wednesday as South Korea’s KOSPI Composite Index gained over 6%.
Key points:
- Bitcoin reached $81,687 on Wednesday, extending a rebound as bid liquidity thickened around $79,000 and $80,000..
- South Korea’s KOSPI Composite Index gained 6.63% as tech stocks rebounded from earlier October losses.
- Analysts remained uncertain about where BTC/USD will build its next trading range as resistance stayed intact near $82,000.
BTC price heads higher with KOSPI up 9.3% week-to-date
Data from TradingView showed BTC/USD extending an intraday rebound to reach $81,687 on Bitstamp.
BTC/USD one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
The pair avoided new lower lows on hourly time frames as bid liquidity thickened around $79,000, and $80,000, per data from CoinGlass.
BTC liquidation heatmap. Source: CoinGlass
Crypto markets strengthened gradually as nerves over AI spending and debt financing eased. The KOSPI finished Wednesday’s trading session 6.6% higher, returning above 6,000 points for the first time since Oct. 14. The index’s week-to-date upside stood at 9.3%.
KOSPI one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
In the US, the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index closed up 1.1% on Tuesday ahead of major corporate earnings from Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Intel. Samsung is due to report Q3 earnings on Thursday.
Speaking to CNBC, Mike Wilson, chief US equity strategist at Morgan Stanley, saw tech stocks entering a new bullish phase on the back of their rebound from a sell-off earlier in October.
“Most of the correction is already over. We’ve been in correction mode for four or five months... the market I think has digested this very efficiently,” he told the network on Tuesday.
Markets continued to expect the Fed to hold rates at its Wednesday meeting, with CME Group’s FedWatch showing 90.6% odds of rates staying in their current 3.75-4% range.
Fed target-rate probabilities comparison for October FOMC meeting (screenshot). Source: CME Group
BTC bear-market comparison puts focus on $82,000 resistance
Commenting on Bitcoin’s repeated dips below $80,000, crypto trader and analyst Rekt Capital drew fresh comparisons to the 2022 bear market.
Related: Bitcoin price analysis sees ‘strong rally’ as old coins become dormant
The weekly chart for BTC/USD resembles 2022’s structure, Rekt Capital said, with it still unclear whether the pair will build a new range above resistance around $82,000.
On weekly time frames, the pair has yet to discard a “macro accumulation range pattern” between $60,000 and $80,000, Rekt Capital added.
BTC/USD one-week chart comparison. Source: Rekt Capital on X.com

Nevis融资7000万美元：嘉信理财入股，AI替理财顾问处理后台工作

动察 Beating AI 快讯，美国财富管理 AI 公司 Nevis 完成 7000 万美元 B 轮融资，由 EQT Ventures 领投，嘉信理财、红杉资本、ICONIQ 等参投。公司成立仅两年，累计融资 1.1 亿美元。《财富》援引知情人士称，本轮估值约 5 亿美元。

Nevis 由三名前 Revolut 高管创办，专门帮理财顾问处理日常事务。比如，客户在会议上提出取款需求，AI 会自动整理信息、准备划款手续，等工作人员审批后再继续执行。客户资料管理、会议记录和财务规划等工作，也能在同一套系统里完成。

Nevis 称，其 AI 已完成超过 10 万项后台任务，部分顾问每周最多节省 10 小时。使用其平台的理财机构涉及超过 7000 亿美元客户资产，一年前只有约 500 亿美元。同期公司营收增长超过 25 倍。

嘉信理财是美国大型金融托管机构，为超过 1.7 万家独立理财顾问机构提供服务。嘉信本月还表示，正在拦截未经授权的 AI Agent 访问客户账户和转移资金。这次投资的 Nevis 通过人工审批和既有托管系统执行操作，试图在金融机构允许的范围内，让 AI 真正完成工作。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
从开源密钥库到AI Agent安全平台，Infisical融资4000万美元

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Infisical 完成 4000 万美元 B 轮融资，估值达到 6 亿美元。这家 YC 孵化的公司靠开源密钥管理起家，帮企业保管 API Key、数据库密码等敏感信息，并控制访问权限。目前已有超过 1300 家企业客户、30 万开发者用户，包括空客、大众汽车、Hugging Face 和 OpenRouter。

随着 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI Agent 开始操作 GitHub、数据库和云服务，密钥安全成了新问题。Agent 经常需要读取外部网页、文档和代码，一旦被其中隐藏的恶意指令诱导，就可能泄露手里的密钥。

Infisical 今年 4 月开源了 Agent Vault，让 Agent 只拿到假密钥。访问外部服务时，请求先经过 HTTPS 代理，由代理在发送前注入真实密钥。这样，即使 Agent 被诱导交出自己持有的密钥，也无法直接泄露真密码。7 月，公司又推出商用版 Agent Proxy，接入原有的企业密钥管理系统。

如今，相关功能已整合进商用 Agent Vault。企业可以按任务给 Agent 授权，设置有效期，随时撤销权限，并记录访问行为。比如，代码审查 Agent 只获得 GitHub 和 Slack 的必要访问权限，任务结束就收回。

Anthropic、Vercel 等公司也采用了类似的凭证代理技术。Infisical 把它做成了可供 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw 等不同 Agent 共用的独立安全基础设施。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374151

腾讯网盘内测：接入多个AI Agent，1TB空间跨产品共享

动察 Beating AI 快讯，腾讯正在内测新版「腾讯网盘」，但这次不打算和百度网盘拼容量。它想做多个 AI Agent 共用的资料库，让不同 AI 能读取同一批文件，接着完成之前的工作。

实测发现，腾讯网盘已支持连接腾讯文档、WorkBuddy，还提供 OpenClaw、DeepSeek Harness 等第三方 Agent 的接入选项。腾讯官网也列出了跨应用搜索，以及通过 CLI、MCP 让 Agent 访问网盘文件等能力。

这款产品早在今年 6 月就已曝光，9 月又接入 WorkBuddy 企业版。此次实测的个人内测版，免费空间只有 5GB。开通 Buddy One VIP 后可获得 1TB，由 WorkBuddy、腾讯文档、ima 和腾讯网盘共用。

字节跳动也在布局类似产品 ADrive，尝试让不同 Agent 共用云端工作目录。两家大厂正在把网盘从文件仓库，变成 AI 可以直接读写的共享工作空间。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
分析师：本轮上涨源于抛压耗尽而非新资金推动，但相关指标仍预示当前处牛市初期

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 28 日，加密市场分析师 Crypto Mommy 引用 CryptoQuant 的数据指出，比特币的已实现市值（Realized Cap）在经历了数月的回调后已重现上升趋势。数据显示，该指标已从 1.057 万亿美元攀升至 1.088 万亿美元，增加了约 310 亿美元（涨幅 2.9%）。分析师认为，这通常是一个好兆头，历史上该指标的回升曾标志着牛市周期的早期阶段。

已实现市值通过计算每枚比特币最后一次链上移动时的价格来评估网络的总体成本基础。该指标的上升通常代表新资本的流入。然而分析师同时表示，在最近的这段时期内，比特币价格从 6.9 万美元上涨至 8 万美元，涨幅高达 16%，远超其成本基础 2.9% 的增速。这种背离表明，近期的价格上涨更多是由于现有持有者的「惜售」情绪，而非大规模外部新资金的推动。

分析师同时警告，已实现市值上升并不能作为价格必涨的绝对保证，在 2025 年末的市场顶部，该指标也曾伴随长期持有者的获利派发而走高。为了确认市场是否正在进入更健康的阶段，分析师建议投资者后市重点关注两个核心信号：一是已实现市值能否保持持续扩张；二是随着资金流入，比特币价格能否成功守住近期的涨幅。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374145

items.content:
机器人AI公司Physical Intelligence估值冲向200亿美元，至今还没有收入

动察 Beating AI 快讯，机器人 AI 初创公司 Physical Intelligence（π）正在洽谈至少 10 亿美元的新融资，目标估值约 200 亿美元。现有投资方 Avenir 和 Lux Capital 有望领投。

这家公司目前还没有收入，但估值已从去年 11 月的 56 亿美元，涨到今年早些时候的 115 亿美元。如果本轮谈成，将进一步升至约 200 亿美元。

Physical Intelligence 成立于 2024 年，创始团队来自 Google DeepMind、斯坦福大学和加州大学伯克利分校，投资者包括贝索斯、CapitalG 和 Thrive Capital。它不造机器人，而是研发能适配不同机器人硬件的通用 AI「大脑」，让机器人学会叠衣服、整理餐具、采摘草莓等实际操作。

10 月 13 日，公司开放 Pi API 测试版，开始让外部开发者上传自己的机器人操作数据，由平台负责微调模型并提供云端推理服务。这样一来，机器人厂商不必从零训练整套模型，就能尝试让自己的机器学会新任务。

同赛道的 Skild AI 今年 1 月完成 14 亿美元融资，估值超过 140 亿美元。与尚无收入的 Physical Intelligence 不同，Skild 今年 9 月宣布，已有超过 60 家付费客户，年化经常性收入突破 1 亿美元，其中约九成来自机器人操作类任务。

两家公司的目标都是把机器人「大脑」做成通用软件，卖给不同硬件厂商。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374144

梁文锋首次跻身中国富豪榜前十，2800亿元身家估值超过丁磊

动察 Beating AI 快讯，10 月 27 日，胡润研究院发布《2026 胡润百富榜》。41 岁的 DeepSeek 创始人梁文锋首次上榜，就以 2800 亿元的估算财富位列中国第七，超过网易丁磊和李嘉诚家族，成为今年身家最高的新上榜企业家。

梁文锋去年还没有进入榜单。胡润解释，主要是因为他此前曾提出「不商业化」。但 DeepSeek 今年开始大规模融资，6 月完成首轮融资，8 月第二轮融资的投前估值已达到约 5000 亿元。10 月，DeepSeek 完成 1060 亿元融资，投后估值超过 6000 亿元。不过，胡润榜单以 9 月 1 日为财富计算截止日期，2800 亿元也只是估算的个人财富。

AI 也正在改写整个富豪榜。字节跳动张一鸣财富增长 2000 亿元，以 6700 亿元重回中国首富；寒武纪陈天石以 2050 亿元进入前十。智谱刘德兵、唐杰分别以 395 亿元、275 亿元首次上榜。胡润统计，今年 160 多位上榜企业家的财富来自 AI 赛道，约占总人数的一成。

items.ai_reason: A concrete, well-documented developer-infrastructure incident: deleting an upstream private repo on GitHub cascaded to delete a customer's private fork within two seconds, with ambiguous audit logs that initially looked like a breach. The impact was limited and fully recovered (local backups restored the SDK), so it is not a material market or security event, but it carries actionable lessons for builders relying on upstream forks — especially Stainless customers affected by the Anthropic acquisition wind-down. Novelty is moderate: the mechanism is a long-standing GitHub rule, newly surfaced with a real victim and a clear remediation request.
items.ai_summary: After Anthropic's acquisition of SDK-generation startup Stainless, a Stainless staffer deleted a private GitHub repo, which triggered GitHub's cascade rule to auto-delete a customer's dependent private fork (Dodo Payments) within two seconds without notice; the team restored its SDK from a local copy and is urging other Stainless customers to convert upstream-dependent forks into standalone repos.

items.content:
GitHub上演离奇删库：被Anthropic收购的公司清理代码，让客户的代码两秒内消失，一度以为是黑客入侵

动察 Beating AI 快讯，今年 5 月，Anthropic 收购了 SDK 生成工具公司 Stainless。后者随即宣布逐步关闭原有托管服务。10 月 27 日，Stainless 的一名人员删除了自家一个 GitHub 私有仓库，没想到连客户的代码也跟着没了。

中招的是支付平台 Dodo Payments。它此前从 Stainless 的私有仓库 Fork（复制）了一份代码，整条 SDK 生成流程都依赖这份仓库。Stainless 删除原仓库后，不到两秒，Dodo 的私有仓库也被自动删除，而且事先没有收到通知。

原来 GitHub 有一条规则：删除私有仓库时，旗下所有私有 Fork 都会被一并删除。更离谱的是，Dodo 的审计日志只显示一名公司外部人员执行了 `repo.destroy`，没有注明这是上游删库引发的连锁操作。联合创始人 Ayush Agarwal 查不到对方的任何授权记录，仓库也不在可恢复列表里，一度以为公司遭到了黑客入侵。

GitHub 客服随后帮助团队查清了原因。好在 Dodo 留有本地代码副本，最终重新上传为独立仓库，SDK 已恢复运行。

Agarwal 希望 GitHub 在审计日志中明确标注上游删库原因。他也提醒其他 Stainless 客户，尽快把仍依赖上游的私有 Fork 转为独立仓库。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374138

Bitcoin ETF inflows climb to $176M as BTC rebounds above $80K
US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $286 million over two days, narrowing October’s net outflows to $26 million as the Crypto Fear & Greed Index remained neutral.
US-listed spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) attracted about $176 million in net inflows on Tuesday, extending their recovery to a second consecutive trading day.
The inflows rose from $110 million on Monday, bringing the two-day total to $286 million, according to SoSoValue data.
The rebound followed nearly $774 million in withdrawals on Thursday and Friday. October net outflows narrowed to about $26 million through Tuesday, while year-to-date net inflows stood at roughly $850 million.
Market sentiment also edged higher. Alternative.me’s Crypto Fear & Greed Index rose to 51 from 48 the previous day, remaining in “Neutral” territory. The reading was still below 63, or “Greed,” a week earlier.
Bitcoin (BTC) traded at about $80,818 at the time of publication, up 1.6% over the past 24 hours, according to CoinGecko.
Meanwhile, US spot Ether (ETH) ETFs continued to see withdrawals, recording about $149 million in net outflows on Monday and Tuesday after four straight weeks of net outflows.
Their October net outflows reached $1.32 billion through Tuesday, putting the month on track for the largest net withdrawals since November 2025.
Related: Bitcoin price analysis sees ‘strong rally’ as old coins become dormant
items.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows climb to $176M as BTC rebounds above $80K

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
Coinbase denies systems breach, says vendor exposed customer data
Coinbase said that an incident at analytics vendor Amplitude exposed some customers’ contact data, but it found no evidence of unauthorized access to its own systems.
Some Coinbase customers’ contact information was exposed in a security incident at analytics vendor Amplitude, the exchange said Wednesday.
The incident impacted a “small subset” of Coinbase customers, along with other Amplitude clients, Coinbase Support said on X.
Coinbase denied that its own systems had been breached and said customer funds were not affected.
The disclosure adds to Wednesday’s reports of cyberattacks affecting both crypto exchanges and traditional financial firms. In South Korea, Bithumb is investigating whether a breach of its internal work platform exposed customer information, while brokerage Daishin Securities reported a leak of personal and credit information belonging to 38,490 customers.
Cointelegraph contacted Coinbase to find out how many customers were affected but had not received a response by publication.
In May 2025, Coinbase disclosed a separate data breach that impacted less than 1% of its monthly transacting users. The exchange estimated reimbursement and remediation costs at up to $400 million.
Related: Bloom bot hackers loot $953K faster than you can microwave popcorn
items.title: Coinbase denies systems breach, says vendor exposed customer data

items.content:
Ghostty 1.4发布：历史记录上限翻5倍，内存反而更省

动察 Beating AI 快讯，终端模拟器 Ghostty 发布 1.4.0，历时 7 个月开发，172 名贡献者提交了近 2900 次代码更新。这次重点解决了长期使用终端时的内存占用问题，性能和图形支持也有明显提升。

新版会在终端空闲时自动压缩屏幕外的历史记录，回看或搜索时再按需解压。普通文本记录压缩后可节省 70% 至 90% 的物理内存，默认历史记录上限也从每个终端 10MB 提高到 50MB。即使存满，通常仍比旧版更省内存。目前支持 macOS 和 64 位 Linux。

后台标签页也不再一直占用 GPU 资源。官方在 macOS 上测试，打开 1 个可见标签和 20 个后台标签，GPU 内存占用从约 385MiB 降至 18MiB。读取终端输出的方式也经过重写，macOS 的数据吞吐量提高 25% 至 55%。直接用 `cat` 输出一份 150MB 文本文件，耗时从 1.5 秒缩短到 566 毫秒。

Ghostty 还补齐了 Kitty 图形协议的动画和相对定位功能。以前在终端里显示 GIF 动图只能看到静止画面，现在可以正常播放。创始人称，这是 Kitty 之外首个完整实现该图形协议的终端。

新版还支持 macOS 27，Linux 换用了基于 EGL 的渲染方式，并加入 `ghostty +ssh`，连接远程服务器时可以自动安装所需的终端配置。

这次还修复了 10 项安全漏洞。其中一项涉及 Kitty 图形指令，攻击者只需诱使终端显示恶意输出，就可能造成程序崩溃、内存异常占用，特定情况下甚至能读取或删除临时目录之外的文件。

items.content:
AA智能指数大换题：Claude夺冠，DeepSeek和GLM落后26分

动察 Beating AI 快讯，AI 评测机构 Artificial Analysis 大幅调整了 Intelligence Index 榜单。新版加入 132 道真实开源项目的编程任务，AI 写出的代码不仅要通过测试，还得达到项目维护者愿意合并的标准。另外新增 70 道科研任务，要求 AI 在终端里实际完成研究流程。为了减少模型提前见过考题的影响，新版 60% 的评分权重来自私有测试集或隐藏答案。

榜单头部依然是 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的天下。Claude Opus 5.5 以 58 分夺冠，GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 分别拿到 57 分、55 分。Kimi K3.1 Pro 得到 46 分，但尚未开源权重。

已经开源权重的 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 和 GLM-5.3 都只有 32 分，落后第一名整整 26 分，甚至不如 Claude Haiku 5.5 的 36 分。

在新增的科研任务中， GPT-6 Astra 完成率达到 63%，Kimi K3.1 Pro 为 34%，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 只有 13%。

虽然 GPT-6.1 Sol 比 Claude Opus 5.5 低 3 分，但按公开 API 价格估算，平均每道综合评测任务只需 1.27 美元，后者要 10.04 美元，接近 8 倍。

新版的题目整体也更费 Token 了，每道任务的输出 Token 中位数从旧版的 3.5 万增加到 5.9 万。

前亚马逊华人女工程师听GPT-4o建议停药后身亡，父母怒告OpenAI

动察 Beating AI 快讯，31 岁的前亚马逊华人女工程师 Bowen Wan，一直靠拉莫三嗪控制病情。2025 年 11 月，她收到亚马逊的裁员通知，即将失去工作，美国工作签证和绿卡申请也受到影响。她担心抗癫痫药物影响语言表达，妨碍找新工作，于是开始向 GPT-4o 咨询如何减药。

诉状称，GPT-4o 为她制定了一套为期 25 天的减药计划，将每日 400 毫克的剂量逐步降至零。不仅如此，它还建议她向医生隐瞒减药计划。当医生要求验血时，她拒绝了检查，GPT-4o 甚至称赞这一决定是有效的「规避策略」。她的主治医生表示，原本的药物一直能控制病情，根本不建议停药。

《纽约时报》审阅了双方超过 27 万条聊天消息。减药期间，Wan 至少 158 次表达担忧，还出现意识混乱、记忆断片等疑似癫痫症状。但 GPT-4o 一再安慰她，说这些反应只是大脑在适应停药。2 月 11 日，她最后一次询问头痛是否危险，GPT-4o 仍告诉她没有危险。

Wan 于 2026 年 2 月 12 日去世，遗体两天后才被发现。法医认定死因为癫痫猝死，尸检显示，她体内的拉莫三嗪浓度仅为通常治疗范围下限的约五分之一。

10 月 27 日，她的父母正式起诉 OpenAI 及 CEO Sam Altman，指控 GPT-4o 在没有医生指导的情况下，让她一步步停掉了控制癫痫的药物。OpenAI 回应称，涉事的 GPT-4o 已在她去世次日退出 ChatGPT，新模型更能识别需要紧急就医的情况。目前，法院尚未认定 GPT-4o 的建议是否应对她的死亡承担法律责任。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374119

美国司法部前脚上诉要禁Claude，联邦采购部门后脚谈下六折新协议

动察 Beating AI 快讯，10 月 26 日，美国司法部刚刚上诉，试图恢复针对 Anthropic 的全联邦禁令。隔天，负责政府采购的联邦总务署（GSA）却宣布扩大合作，让政府机构以六折优惠使用 Claude，按实际用量付费，无需承诺最低消费。

GSA 今年 2 月还公开支持特朗普封禁 Anthropic，并将 Claude 踢出政府采购清单。3 月，加州法院叫停全面封禁，GSA 于 4 月恢复采购资格。8 月，法院进一步判定政府的广泛封禁违法。如今司法部虽然提出上诉，但判决不会因此自动失效。

Anthropic 披露，目前约有 500 个美国联邦、州和地方政府组织使用 Claude，联邦民用机构的使用量过去一年增长约 20 倍。

于是出现了颇为微妙的一幕：司法部还在法庭上争取恢复封禁，政府采购部门却主动谈下新的优惠协议。

items.content:
Anthropic工程经理给新人建议：少刷编程题，多用AI把想法做出来

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 工程经理 Felix Rieseberg 宣布，本月已取消自己团队招聘中的传统编程面试。他此前参与过 Claude.ai、Cowork 和 Claude Code Desktop 的开发。

过去，面试官会让候选人现场写代码，比如完成一道 React 编程题，以此判断编程能力。但现在 Claude 已经能做得更好，而且他发现，团队里表现最好的工程师，也不一定擅长这种考试。

他还发现，一些刚入行的工程师借助 AI，已经能做出比资深员工更好的成果。过去，新人有想法，往往要先写方案、说服主管，再等待设计和开发资源。现在他们可以直接用 AI 做出产品原型，拿实际效果说话。

Anthropic 内部就有一个例子。公司员工早已习惯在终端里使用 Claude Code，但两名入职不久的工程师 Anthony Morris 和 Alice Zhao，动手给它做了一个更方便的图形界面。两人只用一个周末就完成原型，大约八天后推出首个公开版本。

Rieseberg 因此建议年轻工程师，不要只顾着学编程框架、刷面试题。更值得花时间的是了解公司业务，发现实际问题，再借助 AI 把解决方案做出来。他认为，AI 正在缩小新人与老员工之间的技术差距，经验和资历不再像过去那样占优势。

不过，取消传统编程面试后，他自己也还没找到更好的考核方法。目前，他主要看候选人的简历和作品，特别关注那些能够解决实际问题、体现产品判断力的小项目。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/374101
